items.title: 伊朗再襲美軍基地 戰火蔓延至科威特、巴林
items.title_en: Iran Strikes US Bases Again, Conflict Spreads to Kuwait and Bahrain
paras: 美伊衝突再度升級，繼美軍空襲伊朗荷姆茲海峽附近軍事設施後，伊朗對波斯灣地區發起新一輪襲擊，科威特境內美軍基地和巴林接連淪為目標。
伊朗軍方18日（周三）宣布，對科威特境內阿里·薩利姆空軍基地發動襲擊，目標包括美軍無人機和飛彈設施。
科威特軍方證實，防空系統當天攔截來襲無人機，但尚未通報具體損失。科威特外交部隨後譴責伊朗，強調將採取必要措施，維護國家安全。
與此同時，巴林內政部18日凌晨兩度發布警報，要求民眾就地避險。巴林軍方隨後宣布，防空系統成功攔截來自伊朗的空中襲擊。這也是巴林一周內第三次遭伊朗襲擊。
巴林是美國海軍第五艦隊司令部所在地。近期伊朗多次針對當地美軍設施發動無人機襲擊。
新一輪交火發生前一天，美軍戰機空襲伊朗南部格什姆島一處飛彈發射設施。美方稱，此舉是為回應伊朗此前針對美國人員及軍事據點的襲擊。
paras_en: The US‑Iran clash escalated again: after a US airstrike on Iranian military facilities near the Strait of Hormuz, Iran launched a new round of attacks in the Persian Gulf region, targeting US bases in Kuwait and Bahrain.
Iran’s armed forces announced on Wednesday the 18th that they had attacked the Ali Al‑Salim Air Base in Kuwait, striking US drones and missile installations.

Kuwait’s military confirmed its air‑defence systems intercepted the incoming drones that day, though it has not reported specific damage. The Kuwaiti foreign ministry subsequently condemned Iran and said it would take necessary measures to safeguard national security.

At the same time, Bahrain’s interior ministry issued two alerts in the early hours of the 18th, urging residents to seek shelter. The Bahraini military later said its air‑defence systems successfully intercepted the aerial attack from Iran, marking the third Iranian strike on Bahrain within a week.
Bahrain hosts the US Navy’s Fifth Fleet headquarters, and Iran has recently carried out multiple drone attacks on US facilities there.

The day before the new round of fighting, US warplanes bombed a missile‑launch site on Iran’s southern Qeshm Island. The US said the strike was a response to earlier Iranian attacks on American personnel and military sites.

items.title: AI不只餵飽輝達！WSTS：全球前20大晶片商Q3全員成長　SK海力士季增49%居冠、鎧俠緊追
items.title_en: AI Not Just Feeding Nvidia! WSTS: Global Top 20 Chipmakers All Grow in Q3 – SK Hynix Leads with 49% Quarterly Increase, TSMC Close Behind
paras: 根據世界半導體協會(WSTS)最新數據，今年Q3全球半導體市場規模季增27%至4810億美元，年增129%，創下WSTS有史以來最高年增率紀錄，超越第二季110%的紀錄。
數據顯示，AI繼續主導市場增長，輝達當季營收季增20%；三星、SK海力士、美光、鎧俠、閃迪等記憶體廠商受AI驅動，整體營收季增36%。全球前20大供應商營收全數呈季增表現，其中SK海力士(49%)與鎧俠(40%)增幅最為亮眼。
展望第四季，14家給出指引的公司中10家預計增長。超微受資料中心需求推升，預估季增27%；聯發科受AI加速器拉動，預計增29%，輝達增速則從20%放緩至12%，英特爾因PC市場疲軟料將下滑6.1%，Skyworks受智慧手機拖累降6.7%，並在完成與Qorvo合併後首度擠進前二十，安森美則因此跌出榜單，德儀與英飛凌預計分別微降0.1%和2.3%。
今年前三季全球半導體市場規模年增104%，全年規模至少是2025年的兩倍，增速為60多年來首見，各家預測落在110%至112%區間。
至於2027年，機構預測則呈較大分歧：RCD Advisors看23%，半導體情報機構則看60%甚至上看80%。該機構基本假設AI維持強勁但增速放緩，汽車與工業市場健康，記憶體短缺緩解後PC與手機市場復甦。
業界人士指出，當前AI驅動的榮景已超越PC、網際網路與智慧手機時代，正經歷半導體史無前例的黃金時期。
paras_en: According to the latest data from the World Semiconductor Trade Statistics (WSTS), the global semiconductor market size grew 27% quarter‑on‑quarter to $481 billion in Q3, and 129% year‑on‑year, setting a new WSTS record for the highest annual growth rate and surpassing the 110% record of Q2.

The data shows AI continues to drive market growth, with Nvidia’s revenue up 20% quarter‑on‑quarter; Samsung, SK Hynix, Micron, TSMC, and SK Hynix’s memory rivals all saw AI‑driven revenue rise 36% quarter‑on‑quarter. All of the top 20 suppliers posted quarter‑on‑quarter growth, with SK Hynix (49%) and TSMC (40%) delivering the most impressive gains.

Looking ahead to Q4, 10 of the 14 companies that issued guidance expect growth. Intel’s data‑center demand is expected to lift revenue 27% quarter‑on‑quarter; MediaTek, driven by AI accelerators, is forecast to grow 29%; Nvidia’s growth is expected to slow from 20% to 12%; Intel is projected to decline 6.1% due to a weak PC market; Skyworks, dragged down by smartphones, is expected to fall 6.7%; after completing its merger with Qorvo, Skyworks entered the top 20 for the first time, pushing Ansys out of the list; and Analog Devices and Infineon are expected to see slight declines of 0.1% and 2.3% respectively.

For the first three quarters of this year, the global semiconductor market grew 104% year‑on‑year, and the full‑year size is projected to be at least twice that of 2025, with a growth rate that has not been seen in over 60 years. Forecasts for the full year range between 110% and 112%.

Regarding 2027, forecasts diverge significantly: RCD Advisors projects 23%, while semiconductor intelligence firms see 60% or even up to 80%. These firms assume AI will remain strong but at a slower pace, automotive and industrial markets will stay healthy, and after memory shortages ease, PC and smartphone markets will recover.
Industry experts note that the current AI‑driven boom has surpassed the PC, internet, and smartphone eras, and the semiconductor industry is experiencing an unprecedented golden age.

items.title: 黃仁勳重返輝達有解？持股3.58%握董事提名權 尚未表態出招
items.title_en: Could Jensen Huang Return to Nvidia? Holds 3.58% Shares and Nomination Rights, No Decision Yet
paras: 黃仁勳雖已辭去輝達(NVDA-US)執行長職務，但仍可能透過股東身分影響公司未來。《Investing.com》週三(18日)報導，輝達的股東董事提名制度，允許符合持股比例與年限要求的股東，將董事候選人納入公司正式委託書資料。持有約3.58%股份的黃仁勳，似乎符合相關持股門檻，可能藉此爭取董事會重新考慮讓他回歸。
不過，黃仁勳尚未公開表示打算動用這項權利挑戰董事會。提名董事也不代表能取得董事會控制權，更不等於股東可以直接表決讓他重任執行長。
報導指出，依據輝達的委託書提名權(proxy access)規定，連續三年持有至少3%表決權的股東，可提名最多兩名董事候選人，並將其納入公司正式委託書資料，交由股東投票。
黃仁勳及其相關實體持股超過門檻的時間已逾三年，因此看來符合行使這項權利的持股要求，但仍須遵守其他適用規定，候選人也必須符合輝達的獨立性及其他公司治理要求。
這項制度的重要性，在於董事會掌握執行長任命權。如果黃仁勳提名的兩名候選人獲得股東支持、成功當選，便可能在董事會內增加認同其經營方向的聲音，進而影響領導交接等決策，包括重新討論他的去留。
然而，即使兩名候選人全數當選，也不會自動讓黃仁勳掌控董事會。任何改變董事會立場的行動，仍須爭取其他董事支持，並面對股東投票與公司治理規範等挑戰。
黃仁勳11月17日發表聲明，承認自己在私生活上犯下嚴重錯誤，並為造成董事會困擾承擔責任，同時承諾配合獨立調查。他也表示，若董事會認為他的回歸符合股東、員工、公司與美國的最佳利益，他將「很榮幸」重新擔任執行長。
這番表態保留了回歸空間，也顯示他目前仍將決定權交給董事會，尚未公開採取對抗行動。
但輝達管理層的公開立場依然明確。代理執行長克瑞斯(Colette Kress)接受CNBC主持人克萊默(Jim Cramer)訪問時表示：「董事會已決定，不會讓黃仁勳復職。」
她也在公司上調營收展望的法說會尾聲，以「我們能應付」(we got this)為團隊打氣。
另一方面，要求黃仁勳回歸的聲浪持續擴大。
Altimeter Capital執行長 Brad Gerstner 已公開主張讓他復職；Semafor則報導，董事會內部有一派支持他回歸。
一份呼籲輝達恢復黃仁勳職務的網路連署，也已吸引約20萬人簽名，支持者包括馬斯克(Elon Musk)、Y Combinator執行長譚恩(Garry Tan)，以及Epic Games執行長史威尼(Tim Sweeney)。
美國總統川普亦表示，對黃仁勳重返輝達持開放態度。
避險基金大亨、潘興廣場(Pershing Square)執行長艾克曼(Bill Ackman)週三進一步批評，他不認為輝達董事會的處置符合股東最佳利益，也質疑其是否符合董事應負的受託義務。
這些說法屬於艾克曼的公開主張，並非董事會違反義務的法律認定。
目前，董事提名權仍只是黃仁勳可能運用的途徑，尚未成為已公布的行動計畫。
若雙方無法透過協商達成共識，他能否藉由股東支持增加對董事會的影響力，將取決於提名資格、候選人條件、股東投票結果，以及董事會內部的支持程度。
paras_en: Jensen Huang has resigned as Nvidia (NVDA-US) CEO, but he may still influence the company’s future as a shareholder. According to an Investing.com report on Wednesday (18th), Nvidia’s shareholder director nomination system allows shareholders who meet share‑holding and tenure requirements to include director candidates in the company’s formal proxy materials. With about 3.58% of the shares, Huang appears to meet the relevant threshold and could use this to push the board to reconsider his return.

However, Huang has not publicly stated that he intends to exercise this right to challenge the board. Nomination of directors does not guarantee control of the board, nor does it mean shareholders can directly vote him back as CEO.

The report notes that under Nvidia’s proxy‑access rules, shareholders who hold at least 3% voting power for three consecutive years may nominate up to two director candidates and include them in the official proxy materials for shareholder voting.

Huang and his related entities have held shares above the threshold for more than three years, so he seems to meet the holding requirement for exercising this right, but he must still comply with other applicable rules and the candidates must satisfy Nvidia’s independence and other corporate‑governance requirements.

The importance of this system lies in the board’s control over CEO appointments. If the two candidates nominated by Huang receive shareholder support and are elected, they could add voices that align with his management direction, thereby influencing leadership transitions and decisions such as reconsidering his tenure.

Even if both candidates are elected, it would not automatically give Huang control of the board. Any change in the board’s stance would still require support from other directors and face shareholder voting and corporate‑governance challenges.

On November 17, Huang issued a statement admitting serious personal mistakes, taking responsibility for the board’s troubles, and pledging to cooperate with an independent investigation. He also said that if the board believes his return is in the best interests of shareholders, employees, the company, and the United States, he would be "honored" to resume the CEO role.
This statement leaves room for a return and shows that he currently hands decision power to the board, without publicly taking confrontational action.
Nevertheless, Nvidia’s management remains clear in its stance. Acting CEO Colette Kress told CNBC’s Jim Cramer that the board has decided not to allow Huang to return.
She also encouraged the team at the end of a earnings‑forecast call with the phrase, "we got this."
Meanwhile, calls for Huang’s return continue to grow.
Altimeter Capital CEO Brad Gerstner has publicly advocated for his reinstatement; Semafor reported that a faction within the board supports his return.
A petition calling for Nvidia to restore Huang’s position has gathered about 200,000 signatures, including supporters such as Elon Musk, Y Combinator CEO Garry Tan, and Epic Games CEO Tim Sweeney.
U.S. President Trump also expressed an open attitude toward Huang’s return to Nvidia.
Pershing Square CEO Bill Ackman further criticized on Wednesday, saying he does not believe the board’s handling is in shareholders’ best interests and questioned whether it meets fiduciary duties.
These statements are Ackman’s public positions and not a legal determination that the board has breached its duties.
Currently, the nomination right remains a potential avenue for Huang, but it has not become a publicly announced plan.

If the parties cannot reach a consensus through negotiation, whether he can increase his influence on the board through shareholder support will depend on nomination eligibility, candidate qualifications, shareholder voting outcomes, and the level of internal board support.

items.title: 以色列在加薩發起地面攻擊 2025年停火協議以來首次
items.title_en: Israel Launches Ground Attack in Gaza, First Since 2025 Ceasefire Agreement
paras: 以色列地面部隊18日（周三）越過停火分界線，推進至哈瑪斯控制的加薩地帶中部地區，這是自2025年底美國斡旋達成停火協議以來，以軍首次發動地面突襲。
《路透社》援引目擊者說法，稱部分以軍坦克當天駛入停火分界線「黃線」以西主幹道薩拉赫丁路。目前以色列仍控制「黃線」一側約三分之二加薩領土。
巴勒斯坦媒體和社交媒體發布的影片顯示，當地槍炮聲密集，大批巴勒斯坦家庭被迫逃離努塞拉特難民營周邊地區。
一名當地居民對《BBC》阿拉伯語頻道說：「現在情況極其糟糕，以色列軍隊對流離失所者尋求庇護的地區進行無差別射擊。」
以色列軍方隨後證實聯合情報機關辛貝特展開這次行動，目標為打擊非控制區內哈瑪斯基礎設施。以軍稱，部隊攜帶工程機械進入黃線以西，旨在摧毀一條對以軍構成直接威脅的哈瑪斯隧道。
以軍表示，此次突襲規模有限，暗示不存在大規模進攻，但沒有提供襲擊目標或行動將持續多久的細節。
哈瑪斯則發表聲明，警告以軍越界、強迫居民遷離是「危險事態」。哈瑪斯指責以色列看守政府為轉嫁國內危機，蓄意破壞由美國斡旋達成的停火協議，並敦促國際調解人立即介入。
paras_en: Israeli ground forces crossed the ceasefire line on the 18th (Wednesday) and advanced into the central Gaza Strip under Hamas control, marking the first ground assault by the Israeli military since the ceasefire agreement brokered by the United States at the end of 2025.

According to Reuters citing eyewitnesses, some Israeli tanks entered the west side of the ceasefire line, the “yellow line,” on the main road, Salah al-Din Road. Israel currently controls about two‑thirds of Gaza on the yellow line side.
Videos posted by Palestinian media and social media show heavy gunfire and large numbers of Palestinian families forced to flee the area around the Nuseirat refugee camp.
A local resident told BBC Arabic that the situation is “extremely bad” and that Israeli troops are indiscriminately shooting at areas where displaced people are seeking shelter.

The Israeli military later confirmed that the joint intelligence agency, the SIB, launched the operation, targeting Hamas infrastructure in the uncontrolled area. The troops brought engineering equipment west of the yellow line to destroy a Hamas tunnel that posed a direct threat to Israeli forces.
The Israeli military said the raid was limited in scale, implying no large‑scale offensive, but did not provide details on the target or how long the operation would last.

Hamas issued a statement warning that the Israeli incursion and forced displacement of residents constituted a “dangerous situation.” Hamas accused the Israeli government of diverting domestic crises, deliberately undermining the ceasefire agreement brokered by the United States, and urged international mediators to intervene immediately.

items.title: 搶救南科嘉義用水！首座大型海淡BOT案過關 2032年起日供用水10萬噸
items.title_en: Rescue Water Supply for Chiayi, Southern Taiwan: First Large-Scale BOT Desalination Project Approved, 100,000 Tons of Daily Water from 2032
paras: 國家發展委員會今（19）日召開第147次委員會議，審查通過行政院交議、經濟部陳報的嘉義海水淡化廠工程計畫草案，全案將陳報行政院核定。這項總經費高達287.09億元的建設，是國內第1座大型海水淡化廠促參案，預計2032年正式產水，完工後每日可為嘉義地區增加10萬立方公尺自有水源，全面強化大南方供水韌性。
根據國發會規劃，本計畫總經費287.09億元中，高達176.88億元將引進民間投資，其餘110.21億元則由中央公共建設預算支應。這不僅能大幅減輕政府財政負擔，更能藉由民間企業的專業技術與長期營運管理經驗，提升整體建設與供水效率，為南部區域的水源調度注入全新動能。
國發會分析，嘉義地區目前水源主要仰賴蘭潭及仁義潭水庫，平時還須跨區調度雲林及台南地區的水源支援。然而，隨著南部科學園區嘉義園區等高科技產業陸續進駐，當地產業與民生用水需求持續攀升，現有供水能力已難以因應未來成長，一旦遭遇極端枯旱氣候，更將面臨嚴峻的缺水風險。
為解決區域供水瓶頸，政府決定推動不受降雨豐枯影響、產水高度穩定的海水淡化廠。該廠未來產水後，將直接供應嘉義地區公共用水及南科嘉義園區使用，預計2032年達成產水目標。透過擴充當地自有水源，將能有效降低對傳統水庫與跨區調水的依賴，建構更具韌性的常態供水體系。
在工程分工與執行細節上，本計畫擇定布袋商港外港填區作為廠址。由交通部負責辦理填海造陸工程，台灣自來水公司則負責興建輸水管線、受水池及中繼加壓站等基礎設施，相關費用由中央公共建設預算支應。至於核心的海水淡化廠工程，則採取促參BOT方式辦理，交由民間機構負責興建及長達25年的營運。
國發會指出，透過BOT模式引入民間機構，除了資金挹注外，民間團隊在長達25年的營運期間，也能持續導入國際最新的海淡創新技術與節能工法，確保產水品質與數量的長期穩定，為台灣水資源建設立下公私協力的全新標竿。
國家發展委員會主任委員葉俊顯強調，本計畫作為國內首座大型海淡促參案，具有高度指標性意義，對支持大南方產業發展至關重要。由於整體工程涉及填海造陸、促參民間機構、輸水管線建置及地方政府配合等多個執行單位，介面銜接相當複雜，經濟部後續將建立跨部會橫向協調機制，確保工程順利推進。
此外，葉俊顯也要求相關單位持續檢討BOT推動成效，作為未來其他水資源案例的參考。同時，執行團隊也將借鏡新竹及台南海水淡化廠的推動經驗，在工程施作前後與當地居民及農、漁業團體充分溝通，化解地方疑慮，確保各項工程如期如質完成。
paras_en: The National Development Council held its 147th meeting on the 19th, reviewing and approving the draft plan for the Chiayi seawater desalination plant submitted by the Executive Yuan and the Ministry of Economic Affairs. The project, with a total cost of 28.709 billion NTD, is the first large-scale desalination plant in Taiwan and is expected to begin production in 2032, providing an additional 100,000 cubic meters of water per day to the Chiayi region and significantly strengthening the water resilience of the Greater Southern area.

According to the NDC, of the 28.709 billion NTD total cost, 17.688 billion NTD will be sourced from private investment, while the remaining 11.021 billion NTD will come from the central government's public construction budget. This approach will greatly reduce the government's fiscal burden and, by leveraging private companies' expertise and long-term operational experience, improve overall construction and water supply efficiency, injecting new momentum into water resource allocation in the southern region.

The NDC notes that Chiayi currently relies mainly on the Lantan and Renyi reservoirs for water, with additional cross-regional support from Yunlin and Tainan. However, as high-tech industries such as the Southern Taiwan Science Park Chiayi Campus continue to arrive, local industrial and domestic water demand is rising, and existing supply capacity cannot meet future growth. Extreme drought conditions would further exacerbate severe water shortages.

To address regional supply bottlenecks, the government has decided to develop a seawater desalination plant that is unaffected by rainfall variability and provides highly stable output. Once operational, the plant will directly supply public water to Chiayi and the Southern Taiwan Science Park Chiayi Campus, aiming to achieve production targets by 2032. Expanding local water sources will reduce reliance on traditional reservoirs and cross-regional transfers, creating a more resilient normal supply system.

In terms of project division and execution details, the plan selects the Badao Commercial Port Outer Port fill area as the plant site. The Ministry of Transportation and Communications will handle land reclamation, while Taiwan Water Corporation will build water transmission pipelines, intake tanks, and intermediate pumping stations, with costs covered by the central public construction budget. The core desalination plant will be implemented through a BOT model, with a private entity responsible for construction and 25 years of operation.

The NDC points out that using the BOT model to bring in private entities not only injects capital but also allows the private team to continuously introduce the latest international desalination innovations and energy-saving techniques over the 25-year operation period, ensuring long-term stability in water quality and quantity and setting a new public-private partnership benchmark for Taiwan's water resource development.

Executive Director Ye Junxian of the National Development Council emphasized that this project, as Taiwan's first large-scale BOT desalination case, holds significant symbolic value and is crucial for supporting industrial development in the Greater Southern region. Given the project's complexity—encompassing land reclamation, private participation, pipeline construction, and local government coordination— the Ministry of Economic Affairs will establish a cross-ministerial coordination mechanism to ensure smooth progress.

Ye also urged relevant units to continuously evaluate the BOT implementation effectiveness as a reference for future water resource projects. The execution team will draw lessons from the Hsinchu and Tainan desalination plants, engaging local residents and agricultural and fishing groups before and after construction to address concerns and ensure timely, high-quality completion of all works.

items.title: 川普：未來2、3年可開放輝達Blackwell晶片賣到中國 屆時將有更新產品取代
paras: 美國總統川普周四(19日)表示，未來可能允許輝達(NVDA-US)向中國出售備受市場追捧的Blackwell晶片，但前提是該晶片屆時已不再是市場上最先進的產品。
川普正在中國深圳參加亞太經濟合作會議(APEC)峰會，他周四接受福斯新聞(Fox News)專訪時說：「兩年或三年後，如果我還在任，我會說，好吧，你們現在可以出售Blackwell晶片了，因為屆時他們會有其他產品。」
他補充說：「你們知道，他們已經在研發其他產品，將取代Blackwell晶片。但兩、三年後，我會說，就去賣Blackwell吧，因為屆時他們已經有能力做到這一點。」川普的總統任期將於2029年1月結束。

輝達晶片銷中成APEC焦點 

中國從何種管道取得人工智慧(AI)晶片，已成為此次峰會的重要爭議點。輝達執行長黃仁勳因涉及企業治理和國安疑慮的婚外情上周突然離任，其中一名外遇對象正在接受美國政府調查，調查方向包括這名女性是否與中國間諜機構合作，以及是否協助走私晶片。
川普政府本周稍早採取行動，加強對輸往多個國家的處理器出口審查，試圖限制中國企業從遠端取得AI晶片及伺服器的管道。輝達的Blackwell晶片是美中科技競爭的核心之一，其運算能力將大幅提升北京快速發展AI技術的能力。
黃仁勳領導下的輝達一直遊說美國政府批准向中國出售Blackwell晶片，但川普政府始終未同意這項要求，僅允許輝達出售技術較落後的H200處理器。
川普在福斯新聞專訪中說：「你看，我們當時允許出售的，只有那些舊款產品，也就是某種程度上已經半淘汰的晶片。他們甚至沒有賣出多少H200，而H200現在也已經過時。Blackwell則非常先進，是相當新穎的產品。再過一年，它們也會過時。」

美國收緊出口管制、推動AI監督法案

美國國會議員正在推動國會至少未來18個月內禁止輝達向中國出售Blackwell晶片，而川普的最新談話可能讓他們稍感放心。
印第安納州共和黨籍參議員Jim Banks與麻薩諸塞州民主黨籍參議員華倫(Elizabeth Warren)成功推動《AI監督法案》(AI Overwatch Act)，目前已進入年度國防支出法案的最後協商階段。按照過往經驗，通常能在12月通過。

items.title: 蘋果真如投資人所想 是AI投資避風港嗎？
paras: 蘋果(AAPL-US)近期成為科技股資金避風港，但接近37倍的預估本益比，可能已使股價缺乏容錯空間。《CNBC》撰稿人暨選擇權分析師Michael Khouw週三(18日)指出，蘋果服務中斷暴露其營運仍有弱點，投資人應重新評估高估值背後的風險，並可考慮透過賣權價差策略，降低建立下檔保護的成本。
Khouw表示，隨著市場消化黃仁勳離職後輝達的前景，以及其他科技大廠龐大的人工智慧(AI)基礎設施支出，部分資金轉向蘋果。相較於同業大舉投入伺服器與資料中心，蘋果被視為較不受AI投資過熱疑慮影響的標的，吸引尋求相對安全的投資人。
然而，他認為，這種避險敘事已推升蘋果估值。在整體市場本益比開始明顯收縮之際，蘋果仍以接近37倍預估獲利交易，相當於股價已反映高度樂觀預期。一旦負面消息出現，市場對其安全性的信心也可能迅速動搖。
近期蘋果iCloud、Apple Pay及核心支援系統發生大規模服務中斷，成為Khouw重新檢視其估值的切入點。文章指出，官方將事件歸因於內部更新出錯；此前，微軟、美國聯邦航空總署(FAA)及銀行網路也接連出現系統異常。
Khouw認為，多起數位服務中斷集中發生，反映科技基礎設施可能比市場原先認知更脆弱。不過，這是他對系統韌性的判斷，文章並未提出證據，證明各起事件具有共同原因。
他指出，投資人願意承擔多少風險，必須與支付的估值相互衡量。按照他的比較，輝達預估本益比不到10倍，蘋果則接近標普500指數的兩倍；如此高的溢價，需要更強的營運穩定性支撐。
從技術面來看，Khouw表示，蘋果股價持續貼近布林通道等技術指標的上緣，處於對消息面相當敏感的位置。他認為，市場應思考，若要維持上漲，是否還能期待蘋果本益比進一步擴張至40倍，甚至45倍。
依照他的估算，即使估值升至45倍，上漲空間也僅約18%至19%；反之，若蘋果相對大盤的估值溢價，由目前約100%縮減至50%，本益比將降至不到28倍，對應股價可能回落近27%。這是估值變動的情境推算，並非他提出的確定跌幅預測。
儘管股票估值偏高，Khouw指出，蘋果選擇權價格相對大盤仍便宜。
整體市場隱含波動率約位於歷史第93百分位，但蘋果隱含波動率卻略低於過去一年平均；指數選擇權相對蘋果選擇權的價格，也處於第98百分位。
在他看來，股票估值偏高、選擇權相對便宜的組合，提供了重新評估避險部位的時機。
策略上，Khouw提出買進賣權價差，也就是買進一口價平或略為價外的賣權，同時賣出一口相同到期日、履約價更低的賣權。透過收取賣出賣權的權利金，可降低整體支出，也能部分抵銷時間價值耗損的影響，但下跌保護或獲利空間會受到限制。
此外，較深度價外的賣權通常具有較高隱含波動率，交易者可利用這種波動率偏斜，透過賣出較低履約價的賣權，補貼買進賣權的成本。
Khouw的核心看法是，蘋果享有的高溢價，建立在投資人相信它能抵禦其他科技股所面臨風險的基礎上。服務中斷則提醒市場，蘋果同樣存在營運弱點；當股價已反映高度樂觀預期，這些風險更值得納入評估。
輝達股價週三(18日) 震盪翻黑，終場下跌2.89%，收在每股150.96美元，自宣布黃仁勳請辭以來，5個交易日累計下跌13.11%。蘋果(AAPL-US) 升0.15%至每股352.45美元，黃仁勳請辭以來，累計下跌0.89%。

items.title: 歷時8年8個月 中韓貿易協議重大突破！《寄生上流》發行商CJ ENM飆26% 影視旅遊股齊揚
items.title_en: Eight Years and Eight Months Later, Major Breakthrough in South Korea-China Trade Agreement! CJ ENM, Publisher of Parasite, Surges 26% as Film, Gaming, and Tourism Stocks Rally
paras: 中韓擴大自由貿易協定談判取得突破，帶動南韓影視、遊戲及旅遊類股週四(19日)大漲。新協議將擴大南韓企業進入中國市場的機會，並納入電影與遊戲審查不得歧視等承諾。
不過，協議尚未正式簽署或生效，券商也提醒，內容並未明確涵蓋恢復K-pop演唱會及韓劇在中國發行。
韓劇製作公司Studio Dragon週四盤中飆漲29.96%，曾出資奧斯卡獲獎電影《寄生上流》的媒體集團CJ ENM上漲26%，旅行社Hana Tour勁揚18%，電影發行商Showbox上漲9%。遊戲股也同步走高，Krafton與Shift Up分別上漲2.69%及6.57%。
CJ ENM 是韓國大型娛樂與媒體集團 CJ 旗下的核心影視娛樂公司，也是電影《寄生上流》的重要投資與發行推手之一。
南韓產業通商資源部週三表示，歷經8年8個月磋商，南韓與中國已完成擴大自由貿易協定服務及投資領域的談判。
南韓娛樂產業受到中國限制近十年，這項協議可望為影視、遊戲及旅遊業開拓新的營收來源。
依據協議，中國將給予南韓電影、遊戲等產業最惠國待遇，意味南韓業者獲得的待遇，不得低於中國給予第三國業者的待遇。
北京也同意，對線上遊戲及電影的事前審查適用非歧視原則。南韓產業通商資源部指出，這是中國首次在貿易協定中納入此類承諾。
雙方並同意，將共同製作的合作範圍由電影擴大至電視劇、動畫、綜藝節目及紀錄片，為兩國影視業者增加合作空間。
旅遊方面，在中國23個地區營運的南韓旅行社，將可直接招攬中國居民及外籍人士參加出境旅遊，目的地涵蓋南韓及其他國家。
南韓券商韓亞證券週四發布報告，點名Studio Dragon與Hana Tour為協議最直接的受惠者。
韓亞證券估計，若中國串流平台恢復播出先前已購入的韓劇，Studio Dragon每部作品可能增加30億至40億韓元營收，營業利益增幅最高可達50%。
不過，NH投資證券對協議的解讀較為審慎。該券商在週三報告中指出，這是中國長期限制南韓文化內容以來，首次以書面形式呈現的鬆綁進展，但協議並未明確提及恢復K-pop演唱會，或允許韓劇重新在中國發行。
中國在南韓2016年部署美製薩德反飛彈系統(THAAD)後，對南韓實施貿易與文化交流限制，相關措施持續影響南韓娛樂及觀光產業。
南韓產業通商資源部表示，雙方仍在敲定技術性文字，協議尚待正式簽署及生效，實際開放時程與執行方式仍有待確認。
paras_en: South Korea and China achieved a breakthrough in expanding their free trade agreement negotiations, driving a sharp rise in South Korean film, gaming, and tourism stocks on Thursday (19th). The new agreement will broaden opportunities for South Korean companies to enter the Chinese market and includes commitments that film and game censorship will not be discriminatory.

However, the agreement has not yet been formally signed or come into effect, and brokerage firms warned that the content does not explicitly cover the restoration of K‑pop concerts or the re‑release of Korean dramas in China.

Studio Dragon, a Korean drama production company, surged 29.96% during Thursday’s trading session, while media group CJ ENM, which invested in the Oscar‑winning film Parasite, rose 26%. Travel agency Hana Tour jumped 18%, and film distributor Showbox climbed 9%. Gaming stocks also rose, with Krafton up 2.69% and Shift Up up 6.57%.
CJ ENM is the core film and entertainment arm of South Korea’s large entertainment and media conglomerate CJ, and it was one of the key investors and distributors behind the film Parasite.

On Wednesday, South Korea’s Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy announced that after 8 years and 8 months of negotiations, South Korea and China had completed talks on expanding the free trade agreement in the service and investment sectors.
South Korea’s entertainment industry has faced restrictions from China for nearly a decade, and this agreement is expected to open new revenue streams for film, gaming, and tourism businesses.

According to the agreement, China will grant South Korean film, gaming, and related industries most‑favored nation treatment, meaning that the benefits South Korean firms receive cannot be less favorable than those given to firms from third countries.

Beijing also agreed that pre‑review of online games and films will apply a non‑discriminatory principle. The Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy noted that this is the first time China has included such a commitment in a trade agreement.

Both sides also agreed to expand the scope of joint production cooperation from film to include television dramas, animation, variety shows, and documentaries, thereby increasing collaboration space for the two countries’ film industries.

In terms of tourism, South Korean travel agencies operating in 23 Chinese regions will be able to directly attract Chinese residents and foreigners to participate in outbound tourism, with destinations covering South Korea and other countries.
South Korean brokerage Han Asia Securities released a report on Thursday naming Studio Dragon and Hana Tour as the most direct beneficiaries of the agreement.

Han Asia Securities estimated that if Chinese streaming platforms resume broadcasting previously purchased Korean dramas, each Studio Dragon production could see revenue increase of 3 billion to 4 billion KRW, with operating profit growth potentially reaching 50%.

However, NH Investment & Securities took a more cautious view of the agreement. In its Wednesday report, the brokerage noted that this is the first written progress in loosening restrictions on South Korean cultural content since China imposed long‑term limits, but the agreement does not explicitly mention the restoration of K‑pop concerts or the re‑release of Korean dramas in China.

After China deployed the U.S.‑made THAAD anti‑missile system in South Korea in 2016, it imposed trade and cultural exchange restrictions on South Korea, and these measures have continued to affect South Korean entertainment and tourism industries.

The Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy stated that both sides are still finalizing technical wording, and the agreement remains to be formally signed and come into effect. The actual opening schedule and implementation methods are yet to be confirmed.

items.title: 搶救南科嘉義用水！首座大型海淡BOT案過關 2032年起日供用水10萬噸
items.title_en: Rescue Water Supply for Chiayi, Southern Taiwan: First Large-Scale BOT Desalination Project Approved, 100,000 Tons of Daily Water from 2032
paras: 國家發展委員會今（19）日召開第147次委員會議，審查通過行政院交議、經濟部陳報的嘉義海水淡化廠工程計畫草案，全案將陳報行政院核定。這項總經費高達287.09億元的建設，是國內第1座大型海水淡化廠促參案，預計2032年正式產水，完工後每日可為嘉義地區增加10萬立方公尺自有水源，全面強化大南方供水韌性。
根據國發會規劃，本計畫總經費287.09億元中，高達176.88億元將引進民間投資，其餘110.21億元則由中央公共建設預算支應。這不僅能大幅減輕政府財政負擔，更能藉由民間企業的專業技術與長期營運管理經驗，提升整體建設與供水效率，為南部區域的水源調度注入全新動能。
國發會分析，嘉義地區目前水源主要仰賴蘭潭及仁義潭水庫，平時還須跨區調度雲林及台南地區的水源支援。然而，隨著南部科學園區嘉義園區等高科技產業陸續進駐，當地產業與民生用水需求持續攀升，現有供水能力已難以因應未來成長，一旦遭遇極端枯旱氣候，更將面臨嚴峻的缺水風險。
為解決區域供水瓶頸，政府決定推動不受降雨豐枯影響、產水高度穩定的海水淡化廠。該廠未來產水後，將直接供應嘉義地區公共用水及南科嘉義園區使用，預計2032年達成產水目標。透過擴充當地自有水源，將能有效降低對傳統水庫與跨區調水的依賴，建構更具韌性的常態供水體系。
在工程分工與執行細節上，本計畫擇定布袋商港外港填區作為廠址。由交通部負責辦理填海造陸工程，台灣自來水公司則負責興建輸水管線、受水池及中繼加壓站等基礎設施，相關費用由中央公共建設預算支應。至於核心的海水淡化廠工程，則採取促參BOT方式辦理，交由民間機構負責興建及長達25年的營運。
國發會指出，透過BOT模式引入民間機構，除了資金挹注外，民間團隊在長達25年的營運期間，也能持續導入國際最新的海淡創新技術與節能工法，確保產水品質與數量的長期穩定，為台灣水資源建設立下公私協力的全新標竿。
國家發展委員會主任委員葉俊顯強調，本計畫作為國內首座大型海淡促參案，具有高度指標性意義，對支持大南方產業發展至關重要。由於整體工程涉及填海造陸、促參民間機構、輸水管線建置及地方政府配合等多個執行單位，介面銜接相當複雜，經濟部後續將建立跨部會橫向協調機制，確保工程順利推進。
此外，葉俊顯也要求相關單位持續檢討BOT推動成效，作為未來其他水資源案例的參考。同時，執行團隊也將借鏡新竹及台南海水淡化廠的推動經驗，在工程施作前後與當地居民及農、漁業團體充分溝通，化解地方疑慮，確保各項工程如期如質完成。
paras_en: The National Development Council held its 147th meeting on the 19th, reviewing and approving the draft plan for the Chiayi seawater desalination plant submitted by the Executive Yuan and the Ministry of Economic Affairs. The project, with a total cost of 28.709 billion NTD, is the first large-scale desalination plant in Taiwan and is expected to begin production in 2032, providing an additional 100,000 cubic meters of water per day to the Chiayi region and significantly strengthening the water resilience of the Greater Southern area.

According to the NDC, of the 28.709 billion NTD total cost, 17.688 billion NTD will be sourced from private investment, while the remaining 11.021 billion NTD will come from the central government's public construction budget. This approach will greatly reduce the government's fiscal burden and, by leveraging private companies' expertise and long-term operational experience, improve overall construction and water supply efficiency, injecting new momentum into water resource allocation in the southern region.

The NDC notes that Chiayi currently relies mainly on the Lantan and Renyi reservoirs for water, with additional cross-regional support from Yunlin and Tainan. However, as high-tech industries such as the Southern Taiwan Science Park Chiayi Campus continue to arrive, local industrial and domestic water demand is rising, and existing supply capacity cannot meet future growth. Extreme drought conditions would further exacerbate severe water shortages.

To address regional supply bottlenecks, the government has decided to develop a seawater desalination plant that is unaffected by rainfall variability and provides highly stable output. Once operational, the plant will directly supply public water to Chiayi and the Southern Taiwan Science Park Chiayi Campus, aiming to achieve production targets by 2032. Expanding local water sources will reduce reliance on traditional reservoirs and cross-regional transfers, creating a more resilient normal supply system.

In terms of project division and execution details, the plan selects the Badao Commercial Port Outer Port fill area as the plant site. The Ministry of Transportation and Communications will handle land reclamation, while Taiwan Water Corporation will build water transmission pipelines, intake tanks, and intermediate pumping stations, with costs covered by the central public construction budget. The core desalination plant will be implemented through a BOT model, with a private entity responsible for construction and 25 years of operation.

The NDC points out that using the BOT model to bring in private entities not only injects capital but also allows the private team to continuously introduce the latest international desalination innovations and energy-saving techniques over the 25-year operation period, ensuring long-term stability in water quality and quantity and setting a new public-private partnership benchmark for Taiwan's water resource development.

Executive Director Ye Junxian of the National Development Council emphasized that this project, as Taiwan's first large-scale BOT desalination case, holds significant symbolic value and is crucial for supporting industrial development in the Greater Southern region. Given the project's complexity—encompassing land reclamation, private participation, pipeline construction, and local government coordination— the Ministry of Economic Affairs will establish a cross-ministerial coordination mechanism to ensure smooth progress.

Ye also urged relevant units to continuously evaluate the BOT implementation effectiveness as a reference for future water resource projects. The execution team will draw lessons from the Hsinchu and Tainan desalination plants, engaging local residents and agricultural and fishing groups before and after construction to address concerns and ensure timely, high-quality completion of all works.

items.title: 〈焦點股〉康全電訊逆勢攻上漲停 歐洲寬頻出貨成下半年成長動能
items.title_en: Focus Stock: Kangquan Telecom Defies Trend to Hit Upper Limit; European Broadband Shipments Drive H2 Growth Momentum
paras: 網通廠康全電訊(8089-TW)受惠受惠於歐洲客戶寬頻產品自下半年起陸續啟動出貨，預期下半年營收表現可望優於上半年，今(19)日盤中表現強勢，急拉至漲停價39.45元，創下近期波段高點，隨後高檔賣壓湧現漲幅收斂。
展望後續營運發展，康全電訊在先前舉辦的線上法人說明會中指出，將2026年定位為營運調整年，下半年工作重點在於積極爭取客戶訂單並拓展市場版圖。隨著歐洲客戶寬頻產品陸續開始出貨，公司預期下半年整體營收表現可望優於上半年。
針對市場風險與區域布局，由於亞太區主要客戶的訂單出貨高峰落於前一年度，導致客戶端需要較長時間消化庫存，加上部分零組件交期拉長與價格上漲的挑戰，公司正採取審慎的存貨管理政策。
為降低單一市場與客戶集中的風險，康全電訊今年股東會已通過私募現金增資發行普通股案，並持續在歐洲、印度及北美等地區開拓業務，期望2027年歐美及印度的新專案能順利貢獻營收。
paras_en: Network equipment maker Kangquan Telecom (8089‑TW) benefited from European customers’ broadband products beginning shipments in the second half of the year. Anticipating revenue in the second half to outpace the first, the stock surged mid‑session on the 19th to the limit price of NT$39.45, reaching a recent swing‑high before high‑level selling pressure trimmed the gain.

Looking ahead, Kangquan Telecom said in a prior online institutional briefing that 2026 is designated as a year for operational adjustments, with the second‑half focus on aggressively securing customer orders and expanding market coverage. As European customers start shipping broadband products, the company expects overall second‑half revenue to exceed that of the first half.

Regarding market risks and regional positioning, the peak order shipments from major Asia‑Pacific customers occurred in the previous year, leading to longer inventory digestion cycles on the client side. Combined with longer lead times and price increases for some components, the company is adopting a cautious inventory‑management policy.

To reduce reliance on any single market or customer, the shareholders approved a private‑placement cash capital increase issuing common shares this year, and the firm continues to develop business in Europe, India and North America, aiming for new projects in Europe, the U.S. and India to contribute revenue by 2027.

items.title: 〈房產〉全台健身房家數創新高 展店潮或將成大型店面市場救星
items.title_en: Fitness Centers Reach Record High in Taiwan, Expansion Trend May Save Large-Scale Retail Market
paras: 全台健身中心家數越開越多，房仲業根據財政部統計處「營利事業家數及銷售額」資料統計，全台健身中心家數，從2024年已正式突破1000家且年年持續成長，至今年8月，全台健身中心總計已達到1172家，創下歷年新高點。
同時，累計今年1-8月，全台健身中心總銷售額已突破153億元，年增11.4%。
台灣房屋集團趨勢中心執行長張旭嵐表示，現代人對健康意識及生活品質的重視程度提升，目前包括雙北及六都各城市，都陸續設立國民運動中心，許多大樓也將健身房納入基本公設規劃，近年器械皮拉提茲，匹克球以及高爾夫球模擬器蔚為流行，大型連鎖健身房等各種運動訓練教室也持續拓點，也逐漸成為住宅生活圈中重要的休閒機能之一。
張旭嵐提醒，運動場館在建築使用類別主要以D-1和D-5兩大類為主，根據不同設備需求有不同消防和裝修標準，一般商用的店面不見得能符合健身運動場館用途，建議租賃場域前，先確定土地使用分區和建築法規是否符合需求，避免造成後續營業上的困難。
進一步觀察今年六都健身中心家數，台中市以188家後來居上，超越蟬聯冠軍多年的台北市，首度登上冠軍寶座。桃園市則拿下最佳進步獎，從2022年僅有70家，至今年8月已增加至136家，5年增幅達94.3%，成長近翻倍。
台灣房屋集團趨勢中心經理李家妮表示，台中市除了傳統市中心商圈外，近年隨著捷運綠線串聯各大生活圈，串連區域間的交通便利性，加上新興重劃區陸續開發、建商積極布局，帶動居住人口持續成長，尤以北屯區人口增幅最為明顯，台中生活圈分布多元，不僅擴大健身市場的潛在客群，也支撐業者有更多元展店選擇，進一步推升整體產業規模。
而桃園近年成為北北桃生活圈移居熱區，吸引首購及年輕家庭移居，帶動人口持續成長，帶動區域消費力及生活型態更加多元，對健身休閒等生活產業需求也大幅提升。

李家妮表示，隨著健身產業持續擴張，也帶動中大型商用不動產需求。以大型連鎖健身房，通常需要整層甚至包棟多層樓的大坪數空間，選址多鎖定人潮密集的精華商圈，若附帶停車空間更具優勢；而近年中小型健身中心及女性專屬健身房也逐漸增加，主要鎖定周邊上班族及居民，提供下班後就近運動的便利性，因此選址偏好商辦聚落及住宅生活圈，空間需求也相較大型連鎖業者來的彈性，未必追求一樓黃金店面，二樓以上或地下室的百坪空間也受青睞，也為區域型中大型店面帶來租賃需求。
paras_en: The number of fitness centers in Taiwan has been steadily increasing; according to data from the Ministry of Finance’s Statistics Division on "Number of Profit Enterprises and Sales Volume," the total count of fitness centers in Taiwan officially surpassed 1,000 in 2024 and has continued to grow each year. By August of this year, the total number had reached 1,172, setting a new record.
Meanwhile, cumulative sales revenue for fitness centers in Taiwan from January to August this year has exceeded NT$15.3 billion, an 11.4% year‑over‑year increase.

Taiwan Housing Group Trend Center CEO Zhang Xulan noted that modern people’s heightened awareness of health and quality of life has led to the establishment of national sports centers in major cities such as Taipei and the other six capitals. Many buildings now include fitness rooms as part of basic public facilities. In recent years, equipment such as Pilates, pickleball, and golf simulators has become popular, and large chain gyms and various training studios continue to expand, gradually becoming an important leisure function within residential communities.

Zhang Xulan warned that sports venues are mainly classified under building use categories D‑1 and D‑5, each with different fire‑safety and renovation standards depending on equipment needs. Commercial storefronts may not meet the requirements for fitness venues, so before leasing a space, one should confirm that the land use zone and building regulations are appropriate to avoid future operational difficulties.

Looking specifically at the six capitals, Taichung City led with 188 fitness centers, surpassing Taipei City, which had been the long‑time champion, and claimed the top spot for the first time. Taoyuan City earned the best‑progress award, growing from 70 centers in 2022 to 136 by August, a 94.3% increase over five years—nearly double the size.

Taiwan Housing Group Trend Center Manager Li Jianyi explained that beyond Taichung’s traditional downtown business district, the recent extension of the Green Line MRT has linked major residential areas, improving inter‑area transportation. New redevelopment zones and proactive developer activity have spurred population growth, especially in the North‑Tun area, where the population increase is most pronounced. Taichung’s diverse living circles not only expand the potential customer base for fitness but also provide operators with more varied expansion options, further boosting the overall industry scale.

Taoyuan has become a hot relocation area within the Greater Taipei–Taoyuan–Taichung life circle, attracting first‑time buyers and young families. This has driven continuous population growth, diversified local consumption power and lifestyle, and significantly increased demand for fitness and leisure industries.

Li Jianyi added that as the fitness industry continues to expand, demand for mid‑to‑large commercial real estate rises. Large chain gyms typically require entire floors or even multi‑floor buildings, often targeting high‑traffic prime business districts and favoring locations with parking. In contrast, smaller centers and women‑only gyms are increasingly popular, targeting nearby office workers and residents for convenient post‑work workouts. These venues prefer office‑residential clusters and residential life circles, and their space needs are more flexible, often opting for second‑floor or basement spaces rather than first‑floor flagship storefronts, thereby creating rental demand for regional mid‑to‑large stores.

items.title: Visa Agentic Ready第二階段啟動 逾50家夥伴推動AI代理商務交易
items.title_en: Visa Agentic Ready Phase Two Launches, Over 50 Partners Drive AI-Enabled Merchant Transactions
paras: Visa 今 (19) 日宣布，將擴大旗下亞太區 Agentic Ready 計畫，進入計畫第二階段，Visa 將聚焦於商店受理端，攜手收單機構、支付服務供應商、支付網關及特定商家，提升 AI 代理交易的商店受理能力。本計畫啟動之際已有超過 50 家合作夥伴參與，其中包括台灣喬睿科技(Cherri Tech)､應援科技(OEN Tech)與SHOPLINE，並預計於 2027 年持續擴大合作陣容。
Visa 於 2026 年 4 月在亞太區啟動第一階段 Agentic Ready 計畫，聚焦協助發卡機構做好因應代理式商務的準備，並運用 Visa 支付憑證，在受控且符合正式營運標準的環境中進行測試。自計畫推出以來，已有來自亞太區 10 個市場、超過 100 家發卡機構加入，顯示支付生態系正逐步做好準備迎接代理式商務。
隨著個人 AI 助理日益成熟，其應用已從商品推薦逐步延伸至建立購物車，甚至代表消費者完成付款。這也為商家帶來新的挑戰，包括如何辨識可信賴的 AI 代理、管理其資訊存取與操作權限，以及支援 AI 代理完成結帳、支付及售後服務等流程。
為協助商家因應這些轉變，Visa 憑藉在數位支付、代碼化技術、身分驗證、風險管理及支付網路控管等領域的專業經驗，攜手商家、支付服務供應商及科技合作夥伴，共同為代理式商務的發展做好準備。
Visa 亞太區產品及解決方案主管 T.R. Ramachandran 表示，代理式商務要實現規模化發展，關鍵在於商家及支付服務供應商能否安全、可靠地支援 AI 代理發起的交易，同時維護消費者的購物體驗與交易主導權。隨著 AI 代理逐步代表消費者進行商品搜尋、購物及支付，商家與支付服務供應商也需要明確的準則，了解並強化自身因應此類新型交易的準備程度。
他強調，Agentic Ready 計畫正是為此而生，透過串聯 Visa 與持續演進的商務生態系，協助商家為商務發展的新階段做好準備，並在推動創新的同時，持續維護消費者所重視的信任與安全。
參與 Agentic Ready 計畫的商店受理合作夥伴，將與 Visa 共同檢視現有系統、並在真實商務環境中測試由 AI 代理發起的 Visa 交易，藉此找出潛在的技術與流程缺口。
測試範圍涵蓋可信賴 AI 代理的辨識機制，以及 AI 代理在商品探索、結帳與售後互動等環節的運作，同時驗證代碼化支付憑證、身分驗證及交易處理等支付功能，使計畫能充分反映不同市場、支付生態系及商家營運環境的實際需求。
paras_en: Visa announced on the 19th that it will expand its Asia-Pacific Agentic Ready program into a second phase, focusing on the merchant acceptance side. The company will partner with acquirers, payment service providers, payment gateways and specific merchants to enhance the merchant acceptance capabilities for AI‑enabled agent transactions. At the launch of this phase, more than 50 partners are already involved, including Taiwan’s Cherri Tech, OEN Tech and SHOPLINE, and the program is expected to continue expanding its partner roster through 2027.

In April 2026, Visa launched the first phase of the Agentic Ready program in the Asia-Pacific region, concentrating on helping card issuers prepare for agent‑based commerce and using Visa payment credentials to conduct tests in controlled environments that meet formal operational standards. Since the program’s launch, more than 100 issuers from 10 Asia‑Pacific markets have joined, indicating that the payment ecosystem is gradually getting ready to embrace agent‑based commerce.

As personal AI assistants mature, their applications have evolved from product recommendations to building shopping carts and even completing payments on behalf of consumers. This presents new challenges for merchants, including how to identify trustworthy AI agents, manage their data access and operational permissions, and support AI agents in completing checkout, payment and post‑sale service processes.

To help merchants adapt to these changes, Visa leverages its expertise in digital payments, tokenization, identity verification, risk management and payment network control, partnering with merchants, payment service providers and technology partners to prepare for the development of agent‑based commerce.

T.R. Ramachandran, Vice President of Products and Solutions for Visa Asia‑Pacific, said that scaling agent‑based commerce hinges on whether merchants and payment service providers can securely and reliably support transactions initiated by AI agents while preserving the consumer shopping experience and transaction control. As AI agents increasingly represent consumers in product search, shopping and payment, merchants and payment service providers also need clear guidelines to understand and strengthen their readiness for this new type of transaction.

He emphasized that the Agentic Ready program was created for this purpose, connecting Visa with the evolving commerce ecosystem to help merchants prepare for a new phase of business development while maintaining the trust and security that consumers value.

Merchant acceptance partners participating in the Agentic Ready program will work with Visa to review existing systems and test Visa transactions initiated by AI agents in real business environments, identifying potential technical and process gaps.

The testing scope covers mechanisms for identifying trustworthy AI agents, as well as the operation of AI agents in product exploration, checkout and post‑sale interactions. It also verifies tokenized payment credentials, identity verification and transaction processing, ensuring the program fully reflects the real‑world needs of different markets, payment ecosystems and merchant operating environments.
