items.title: 〈焦點股〉喬山進入銷售旺季全年營收可望再創高 逆風走揚
items.title_en: Focus Stock: Qiaoshang Enters Peak Sales Season, Full-Year Revenue Expected to Reach New High Amid Adverse Conditions
paras: 健身器材廠喬山(1736-TW)累計今年前三季營收站上400億元關卡，稅後純益18.05億元，年增逾7成，每股純益5.95元，隨著時序進到第四季，迎來銷售旺季，11、12月為全年營運高峰，預期在旺季需求帶動下，全年營收可望再創高，激勵喬山今(19)日逆風走揚，力拚站穩月線。
喬山今天早盤以114元開高，盤中最高漲至118.5元，大漲逾半根停板，不過隨後漲幅收斂，截至10點40分，股價暫報113元，漲幅約0.89%，力拚站穩月線，成交量約300張。三大法人持續敲進喬山，連續5個交易日買超，合計買超478張。
喬山積極拓展商用市場，今年推出大量產品布局與開發，目前喬山於全球商用市場市占率接近5成，新產品線有助提升市占率，預期相關布局效益將於明年逐步發酵，目標在2028年達到70%的市占率。同時，也預計於明年增設3家子公司，以擴大服務範圍。
家用市場部分，喬山指出，明年成長動能主要來自Bowflex，由於家用市場競爭激烈，重點將放在提升毛利率，因此目前與知名健身品牌合作，增加來店客數和銷售，有望帶動門市獲利。此外，也期望有突破性的產品線，鎖定高階家用健身市場。
喬山第三季營收149.6億元，季增12.76%，年增24.24%；毛利率53.64%，季減9.18個百分點，年增1.99個百分點；營益率8.63%，季減6.23個百分點，年增2.19個百分點；稅後純益8.12億元，季減16.21%，年增25.36%，每股純益2.68元。
喬山累計今年前三季營收400.19億元，年增14.48%；毛利率56%，年增4.34個百分點；營益率7.92%，年增3.07個百分點；稅後純益18.05億元，年增74.2%，每股純益5.95元。
paras_en: Qiaoshang (1736-TW), a fitness equipment manufacturer, has surpassed the 40‑billion‑NT dollar mark in cumulative revenue for the first three quarters of the year, with after‑tax net profit of 1.805 billion NT and a year‑on‑year increase of more than 70%. Earnings per share reached 5.95 NT. As the year moves into the fourth quarter, the company enters its peak sales season, with November and December being the annual operating high points. With demand driven by the season, full‑year revenue is expected to set a new record, prompting Qiaoshang to rally against the wind on the 19th and aim to hold the monthly line.

Qiaoshang opened the morning session at 114 NT, rising to a high of 118.5 NT—an increase of more than half a point to the daily limit. The rally then tapered, and by 10:40 a.m. the share price was 113 NT, up about 0.89%, as the company sought to maintain the monthly line. Trading volume was around 300 contracts. The three major institutional investors continued to buy Qiaoshang, with five consecutive trading days of net purchases totaling 478 contracts.

Qiaoshang is actively expanding into the commercial market. This year it launched a large number of products and development plans. Currently, Qiaoshang holds nearly 50% of the global commercial market share. New product lines are expected to boost market share, with the benefits of these initiatives anticipated to mature gradually next year. The target is to reach 70% market share by 2028. Additionally, the company plans to establish three new subsidiaries next year to broaden its service scope.

In the residential market, Qiaoshang noted that next year’s growth momentum will mainly come from Bowflex. Due to intense competition in the home market, the focus will be on improving gross margin. The company is currently partnering with well‑known fitness brands to increase foot traffic and sales, which is expected to drive store profitability. It also hopes to launch breakthrough product lines targeting the high‑end home fitness market.

Qiaoshang’s third‑quarter revenue was 14.96 billion NT, a 12.76% quarter‑on‑quarter increase and 24.24% year‑on‑year growth. Gross margin was 53.64%, down 9.18 percentage points quarter‑on‑quarter but up 1.99 percentage points year‑on‑year. Operating margin was 8.63%, down 6.23 percentage points quarter‑on‑quarter but up 2.19 percentage points year‑on‑year. After‑tax net profit was 812 million NT, down 16.21% quarter‑on‑quarter but up 25.36% year‑on‑year, with earnings per share of 2.68 NT.

Qiaoshang’s cumulative revenue for the first three quarters of the year reached 40.019 billion NT, a 14.48% year‑on‑year increase. Gross margin was 56%, up 4.34 percentage points year‑on‑year. Operating margin was 7.92%, up 3.07 percentage points year‑on‑year. After‑tax net profit was 1.805 billion NT, up 74.2% year‑on‑year, with earnings per share of 5.95 NT.

items.title: 松川持續投資擴充推營收將續攻堅登高 首見本土投信進場建倉
items.title_en: Matsushita Continues to Expand Investments to Drive Revenue Growth, Targets New Highs; Domestic Asset Managers Begin Building Positions
paras: 在AI及儲能市場需求持續強勁帶動下，繼電器廠松川精密(7788-TW)營運將持續擴張。松川精密擬以發行總額15億元的無擔保可轉換公司債(CB)進行市場籌資，2027年資本支出規劃將維持於4億元的水準，法人預估松川精密2027年營收還會有雙位數成長改寫歷史新高；投信也進行建倉並在昨(18)日首度進場小買超128張。
包括松川的首度送件透過資本市場籌資及授信的對松川建立持股部位，都是松川2025年10月16日上市掛牌以來，松川精密本次擬發行無擔保可轉換公司債籌資，主辦券商為元大證券。松川精密並指出，此一市場籌資用途償還銀行借款及充實營運資金。
松川精密營運持續大幅成長，2026年前9月營收68.52億元，已超越2025年全年營收總和，年增幅達44%。松川10月營收8.49億元，創同期新高，年增53.62%，1-10月營收77.02億元，年增45%。
松川精密的最新財報顯示，2026年1-9月營收68.52億元，已超越2025年全年營收總和，稅後純益6.66億元，年增3.2倍，每股純益8.35元，法人估全年有機會每股賺逾11元，也將創新高。
松川精密在涵蓋數據中心 (CSP) 變頻器、伺服器電源與不斷電系統 (UPS)，高電壓大電流產品從 2025 下半年起開始明顯放量，同時，推升松川在營收高速成長。
paras_en: Under the sustained strong demand in the AI and energy storage markets, Matsushita Precision (7788‑TW) plans to continue expanding its operations. The company intends to raise 1.5 billion NTD through the issuance of unsecured convertible bonds (CBs). Capital expenditure for 2027 is projected to remain at 400 million NTD, and analysts estimate that Matsushita’s 2027 revenue will still grow double‑digit, setting a new historical high. Asset managers have begun building positions, with a first small purchase of 128 lots made on the 18th.

Matsushita’s first capital‑market fundraising and credit line to establish a stake in the company occurred on October 16, 2025, when the firm listed. The planned issuance of unsecured convertible bonds is being handled by Yuanta Securities. Matsushita clarified that the proceeds will be used to repay bank loans and bolster working capital.

Matsushita’s operations have continued to grow sharply. Revenue for the first nine months of 2026 reached 6.852 billion NTD, surpassing the total revenue for all of 2025, with a year‑on‑year increase of 44%. Revenue in October was 849 million NTD, a new high for the month, up 53.62% year‑on‑year. Revenue from January to October 2026 totaled 7.702 billion NTD, up 45% year‑on‑year.

Matsushita’s latest financial report shows that revenue for January‑September 2026 was 6.852 billion NTD, exceeding the total revenue for all of 2025. Net profit after tax was 666 million NTD, a 3.2‑fold increase year‑on‑year, with earnings per share of 8.35 NTD. Analysts estimate that the company could earn over 11 NTD per share for the full year, setting a new high.

Matsushita’s product portfolio includes data‑center (CSP) variable‑frequency drives, server power supplies, and uninterruptible power supplies (UPS), as well as high‑voltage, high‑current products that have seen significant volume growth since the second half of 2025, driving the company’s rapid revenue expansion.

items.title: 台股重挫連破三個防線 法人憂黃仁勳事件抵銷台灣AI紅利溢價
items.title_en: Taiwan Stock Market Falls Through Three Resistance Levels as Corporate Concerns Over Jensen Huang Offset Taiwan AI Premium
paras: 台股今(19)日再度重挫，盤中跌點超過1300點，連破40000、39000點大關，跌破年線支撐，新台幣也再度見到33元的價位，元大投顧分析，若輝達執行長換成專業經理人，未來可能擠壓台廠利潤，抵銷台灣AI紅利溢價。
元大投顧指出，美國商務部於11月16日宣布擴大先進AI晶片出口管制，重點防堵經由第三國轉運或代工規避限制的漏洞，強硬派代表以國務卿與財長為首，緊盯Non-China與非紅供應鏈等國安議題，加上明年1月起民主黨將主導國會監督，皆讓AI發展面臨緊縮。
而首當其衝的輝達，股價近腰斬，前瞻本益比僅剩10倍，賣壓後座力波及台股，元大投顧認為，畢竟黃仁勳引領技術創新，若執行長換成專業經理人，未來可能擠壓台廠利潤，進而抵銷台灣AI紅利溢價。
另一方面，外資連續提款方向不變，壓迫短中期均線快速下彎，技術面KD指標交叉向下，型態顯示上檔籌碼沉重，指數進行第二隻腳打底測試，短線先留意年線約39300點與前低37837點之間的防守力道。
統一投顧則指出，目前KD呈現向下死亡交叉、MACD黑柱體持續擴大，上方套牢浮額仍待時間化解，短期盤勢偏向大區間震盪。
paras_en: Taiwan's stock market fell sharply again today (19), dropping over 1,300 points during the session and breaking through the 40,000 and 39,000 levels, falling below the yearly support line; the New Taiwan dollar also slipped to the 33 mark. Yuantai Investment Consulting analyzed that if NVIDIA’s CEO were replaced by a professional manager, future pressure on Taiwanese chipmakers’ profits could offset Taiwan’s AI premium.

Yuantai Investment Consulting noted that the U.S. Department of Commerce announced on November 16 that it would expand export controls on advanced AI chips, targeting loopholes that allow transit through third countries or contract manufacturing. Hardliners, led by the Secretary of State and the Treasury Secretary, are closely monitoring national security issues related to non‑China and non‑red supply chains, and with the Democratic Party expected to lead congressional oversight from January next year, AI development faces tightening constraints.

NVIDIA, the first to feel the impact, has seen its shares nearly halve, with a forward P/E ratio of only 10 times. The selling pressure has spilled over into Taiwanese stocks. Yuantai Investment Consulting believes that although Jensen Huang drives technological innovation, replacing the CEO with a professional manager could squeeze Taiwanese chipmakers’ profits and thereby negate Taiwan’s AI premium.

On the other hand, foreign investors continue to withdraw, forcing short‑ and medium‑term moving averages to bend sharply downward. Technical indicators show a downward crossover of the KD line, and the pattern indicates heavy upper‑level holdings. The index is conducting a second “foot” bottom test; in the short term, attention should focus on the defensive strength between the yearly support around 39,300 points and the previous low of 37,837 points.

Unified Investment Consulting pointed out that the KD line currently shows a downward death cross, the MACD black bars continue to expand, and the upper trapped float remains to be resolved over time. The short‑term market trend leans toward a wide‑range oscillation.

items.title: AI不只餵飽輝達！WSTS：全球前20大晶片商Q3全員成長　SK海力士季增49%居冠、鎧俠緊追
items.title_en: AI Not Just Feeding Nvidia! WSTS: Global Top 20 Chipmakers All Grow in Q3 – SK Hynix Leads with 49% Quarterly Increase, TSMC Close Behind
paras: 根據世界半導體協會(WSTS)最新數據，今年Q3全球半導體市場規模季增27%至4810億美元，年增129%，創下WSTS有史以來最高年增率紀錄，超越第二季110%的紀錄。
數據顯示，AI繼續主導市場增長，輝達當季營收季增20%；三星、SK海力士、美光、鎧俠、閃迪等記憶體廠商受AI驅動，整體營收季增36%。全球前20大供應商營收全數呈季增表現，其中SK海力士(49%)與鎧俠(40%)增幅最為亮眼。
展望第四季，14家給出指引的公司中10家預計增長。超微受資料中心需求推升，預估季增27%；聯發科受AI加速器拉動，預計增29%，輝達增速則從20%放緩至12%，英特爾因PC市場疲軟料將下滑6.1%，Skyworks受智慧手機拖累降6.7%，並在完成與Qorvo合併後首度擠進前二十，安森美則因此跌出榜單，德儀與英飛凌預計分別微降0.1%和2.3%。
今年前三季全球半導體市場規模年增104%，全年規模至少是2025年的兩倍，增速為60多年來首見，各家預測落在110%至112%區間。
至於2027年，機構預測則呈較大分歧：RCD Advisors看23%，半導體情報機構則看60%甚至上看80%。該機構基本假設AI維持強勁但增速放緩，汽車與工業市場健康，記憶體短缺緩解後PC與手機市場復甦。
業界人士指出，當前AI驅動的榮景已超越PC、網際網路與智慧手機時代，正經歷半導體史無前例的黃金時期。
paras_en: According to the latest data from the World Semiconductor Trade Statistics (WSTS), the global semiconductor market size grew 27% quarter‑on‑quarter to $481 billion in Q3, and 129% year‑on‑year, setting a new WSTS record for the highest annual growth rate and surpassing the 110% record of Q2.

The data shows AI continues to drive market growth, with Nvidia’s revenue up 20% quarter‑on‑quarter; Samsung, SK Hynix, Micron, TSMC, and SK Hynix’s memory rivals all saw AI‑driven revenue rise 36% quarter‑on‑quarter. All of the top 20 suppliers posted quarter‑on‑quarter growth, with SK Hynix (49%) and TSMC (40%) delivering the most impressive gains.

Looking ahead to Q4, 10 of the 14 companies that issued guidance expect growth. Intel’s data‑center demand is expected to lift revenue 27% quarter‑on‑quarter; MediaTek, driven by AI accelerators, is forecast to grow 29%; Nvidia’s growth is expected to slow from 20% to 12%; Intel is projected to decline 6.1% due to a weak PC market; Skyworks, dragged down by smartphones, is expected to fall 6.7%; after completing its merger with Qorvo, Skyworks entered the top 20 for the first time, pushing Ansys out of the list; and Analog Devices and Infineon are expected to see slight declines of 0.1% and 2.3% respectively.

For the first three quarters of this year, the global semiconductor market grew 104% year‑on‑year, and the full‑year size is projected to be at least twice that of 2025, with a growth rate that has not been seen in over 60 years. Forecasts for the full year range between 110% and 112%.

Regarding 2027, forecasts diverge significantly: RCD Advisors projects 23%, while semiconductor intelligence firms see 60% or even up to 80%. These firms assume AI will remain strong but at a slower pace, automotive and industrial markets will stay healthy, and after memory shortages ease, PC and smartphone markets will recover.
Industry experts note that the current AI‑driven boom has surpassed the PC, internet, and smartphone eras, and the semiconductor industry is experiencing an unprecedented golden age.

items.title: 黃仁勳重返輝達有解？持股3.58%握董事提名權 尚未表態出招
items.title_en: Could Jensen Huang Return to Nvidia? Holds 3.58% Shares and Nomination Rights, No Decision Yet
paras: 黃仁勳雖已辭去輝達(NVDA-US)執行長職務，但仍可能透過股東身分影響公司未來。《Investing.com》週三(18日)報導，輝達的股東董事提名制度，允許符合持股比例與年限要求的股東，將董事候選人納入公司正式委託書資料。持有約3.58%股份的黃仁勳，似乎符合相關持股門檻，可能藉此爭取董事會重新考慮讓他回歸。
不過，黃仁勳尚未公開表示打算動用這項權利挑戰董事會。提名董事也不代表能取得董事會控制權，更不等於股東可以直接表決讓他重任執行長。
報導指出，依據輝達的委託書提名權(proxy access)規定，連續三年持有至少3%表決權的股東，可提名最多兩名董事候選人，並將其納入公司正式委託書資料，交由股東投票。
黃仁勳及其相關實體持股超過門檻的時間已逾三年，因此看來符合行使這項權利的持股要求，但仍須遵守其他適用規定，候選人也必須符合輝達的獨立性及其他公司治理要求。
這項制度的重要性，在於董事會掌握執行長任命權。如果黃仁勳提名的兩名候選人獲得股東支持、成功當選，便可能在董事會內增加認同其經營方向的聲音，進而影響領導交接等決策，包括重新討論他的去留。
然而，即使兩名候選人全數當選，也不會自動讓黃仁勳掌控董事會。任何改變董事會立場的行動，仍須爭取其他董事支持，並面對股東投票與公司治理規範等挑戰。
黃仁勳11月17日發表聲明，承認自己在私生活上犯下嚴重錯誤，並為造成董事會困擾承擔責任，同時承諾配合獨立調查。他也表示，若董事會認為他的回歸符合股東、員工、公司與美國的最佳利益，他將「很榮幸」重新擔任執行長。
這番表態保留了回歸空間，也顯示他目前仍將決定權交給董事會，尚未公開採取對抗行動。
但輝達管理層的公開立場依然明確。代理執行長克瑞斯(Colette Kress)接受CNBC主持人克萊默(Jim Cramer)訪問時表示：「董事會已決定，不會讓黃仁勳復職。」
她也在公司上調營收展望的法說會尾聲，以「我們能應付」(we got this)為團隊打氣。
另一方面，要求黃仁勳回歸的聲浪持續擴大。
Altimeter Capital執行長 Brad Gerstner 已公開主張讓他復職；Semafor則報導，董事會內部有一派支持他回歸。
一份呼籲輝達恢復黃仁勳職務的網路連署，也已吸引約20萬人簽名，支持者包括馬斯克(Elon Musk)、Y Combinator執行長譚恩(Garry Tan)，以及Epic Games執行長史威尼(Tim Sweeney)。
美國總統川普亦表示，對黃仁勳重返輝達持開放態度。
避險基金大亨、潘興廣場(Pershing Square)執行長艾克曼(Bill Ackman)週三進一步批評，他不認為輝達董事會的處置符合股東最佳利益，也質疑其是否符合董事應負的受託義務。
這些說法屬於艾克曼的公開主張，並非董事會違反義務的法律認定。
目前，董事提名權仍只是黃仁勳可能運用的途徑，尚未成為已公布的行動計畫。
若雙方無法透過協商達成共識，他能否藉由股東支持增加對董事會的影響力，將取決於提名資格、候選人條件、股東投票結果，以及董事會內部的支持程度。
paras_en: Jensen Huang has resigned as Nvidia (NVDA-US) CEO, but he may still influence the company’s future as a shareholder. According to an Investing.com report on Wednesday (18th), Nvidia’s shareholder director nomination system allows shareholders who meet share‑holding and tenure requirements to include director candidates in the company’s formal proxy materials. With about 3.58% of the shares, Huang appears to meet the relevant threshold and could use this to push the board to reconsider his return.

However, Huang has not publicly stated that he intends to exercise this right to challenge the board. Nomination of directors does not guarantee control of the board, nor does it mean shareholders can directly vote him back as CEO.

The report notes that under Nvidia’s proxy‑access rules, shareholders who hold at least 3% voting power for three consecutive years may nominate up to two director candidates and include them in the official proxy materials for shareholder voting.

Huang and his related entities have held shares above the threshold for more than three years, so he seems to meet the holding requirement for exercising this right, but he must still comply with other applicable rules and the candidates must satisfy Nvidia’s independence and other corporate‑governance requirements.

The importance of this system lies in the board’s control over CEO appointments. If the two candidates nominated by Huang receive shareholder support and are elected, they could add voices that align with his management direction, thereby influencing leadership transitions and decisions such as reconsidering his tenure.

Even if both candidates are elected, it would not automatically give Huang control of the board. Any change in the board’s stance would still require support from other directors and face shareholder voting and corporate‑governance challenges.

On November 17, Huang issued a statement admitting serious personal mistakes, taking responsibility for the board’s troubles, and pledging to cooperate with an independent investigation. He also said that if the board believes his return is in the best interests of shareholders, employees, the company, and the United States, he would be "honored" to resume the CEO role.
This statement leaves room for a return and shows that he currently hands decision power to the board, without publicly taking confrontational action.
Nevertheless, Nvidia’s management remains clear in its stance. Acting CEO Colette Kress told CNBC’s Jim Cramer that the board has decided not to allow Huang to return.
She also encouraged the team at the end of a earnings‑forecast call with the phrase, "we got this."
Meanwhile, calls for Huang’s return continue to grow.
Altimeter Capital CEO Brad Gerstner has publicly advocated for his reinstatement; Semafor reported that a faction within the board supports his return.
A petition calling for Nvidia to restore Huang’s position has gathered about 200,000 signatures, including supporters such as Elon Musk, Y Combinator CEO Garry Tan, and Epic Games CEO Tim Sweeney.
U.S. President Trump also expressed an open attitude toward Huang’s return to Nvidia.
Pershing Square CEO Bill Ackman further criticized on Wednesday, saying he does not believe the board’s handling is in shareholders’ best interests and questioned whether it meets fiduciary duties.
These statements are Ackman’s public positions and not a legal determination that the board has breached its duties.
Currently, the nomination right remains a potential avenue for Huang, but it has not become a publicly announced plan.

If the parties cannot reach a consensus through negotiation, whether he can increase his influence on the board through shareholder support will depend on nomination eligibility, candidate qualifications, shareholder voting outcomes, and the level of internal board support.

items.title: 川普：未來2、3年可開放輝達Blackwell晶片賣到中國 屆時將有更新產品取代
paras: 美國總統川普周四(19日)表示，未來可能允許輝達(NVDA-US)向中國出售備受市場追捧的Blackwell晶片，但前提是該晶片屆時已不再是市場上最先進的產品。
川普正在中國深圳參加亞太經濟合作會議(APEC)峰會，他周四接受福斯新聞(Fox News)專訪時說：「兩年或三年後，如果我還在任，我會說，好吧，你們現在可以出售Blackwell晶片了，因為屆時他們會有其他產品。」
他補充說：「你們知道，他們已經在研發其他產品，將取代Blackwell晶片。但兩、三年後，我會說，就去賣Blackwell吧，因為屆時他們已經有能力做到這一點。」川普的總統任期將於2029年1月結束。

輝達晶片銷中成APEC焦點 

中國從何種管道取得人工智慧(AI)晶片，已成為此次峰會的重要爭議點。輝達執行長黃仁勳因涉及企業治理和國安疑慮的婚外情上周突然離任，其中一名外遇對象正在接受美國政府調查，調查方向包括這名女性是否與中國間諜機構合作，以及是否協助走私晶片。
川普政府本周稍早採取行動，加強對輸往多個國家的處理器出口審查，試圖限制中國企業從遠端取得AI晶片及伺服器的管道。輝達的Blackwell晶片是美中科技競爭的核心之一，其運算能力將大幅提升北京快速發展AI技術的能力。
黃仁勳領導下的輝達一直遊說美國政府批准向中國出售Blackwell晶片，但川普政府始終未同意這項要求，僅允許輝達出售技術較落後的H200處理器。
川普在福斯新聞專訪中說：「你看，我們當時允許出售的，只有那些舊款產品，也就是某種程度上已經半淘汰的晶片。他們甚至沒有賣出多少H200，而H200現在也已經過時。Blackwell則非常先進，是相當新穎的產品。再過一年，它們也會過時。」

美國收緊出口管制、推動AI監督法案

美國國會議員正在推動國會至少未來18個月內禁止輝達向中國出售Blackwell晶片，而川普的最新談話可能讓他們稍感放心。
印第安納州共和黨籍參議員Jim Banks與麻薩諸塞州民主黨籍參議員華倫(Elizabeth Warren)成功推動《AI監督法案》(AI Overwatch Act)，目前已進入年度國防支出法案的最後協商階段。按照過往經驗，通常能在12月通過。

items.title: 蘋果真如投資人所想 是AI投資避風港嗎？
paras: 蘋果(AAPL-US)近期成為科技股資金避風港，但接近37倍的預估本益比，可能已使股價缺乏容錯空間。《CNBC》撰稿人暨選擇權分析師Michael Khouw週三(18日)指出，蘋果服務中斷暴露其營運仍有弱點，投資人應重新評估高估值背後的風險，並可考慮透過賣權價差策略，降低建立下檔保護的成本。
Khouw表示，隨著市場消化黃仁勳離職後輝達的前景，以及其他科技大廠龐大的人工智慧(AI)基礎設施支出，部分資金轉向蘋果。相較於同業大舉投入伺服器與資料中心，蘋果被視為較不受AI投資過熱疑慮影響的標的，吸引尋求相對安全的投資人。
然而，他認為，這種避險敘事已推升蘋果估值。在整體市場本益比開始明顯收縮之際，蘋果仍以接近37倍預估獲利交易，相當於股價已反映高度樂觀預期。一旦負面消息出現，市場對其安全性的信心也可能迅速動搖。
近期蘋果iCloud、Apple Pay及核心支援系統發生大規模服務中斷，成為Khouw重新檢視其估值的切入點。文章指出，官方將事件歸因於內部更新出錯；此前，微軟、美國聯邦航空總署(FAA)及銀行網路也接連出現系統異常。
Khouw認為，多起數位服務中斷集中發生，反映科技基礎設施可能比市場原先認知更脆弱。不過，這是他對系統韌性的判斷，文章並未提出證據，證明各起事件具有共同原因。
他指出，投資人願意承擔多少風險，必須與支付的估值相互衡量。按照他的比較，輝達預估本益比不到10倍，蘋果則接近標普500指數的兩倍；如此高的溢價，需要更強的營運穩定性支撐。
從技術面來看，Khouw表示，蘋果股價持續貼近布林通道等技術指標的上緣，處於對消息面相當敏感的位置。他認為，市場應思考，若要維持上漲，是否還能期待蘋果本益比進一步擴張至40倍，甚至45倍。
依照他的估算，即使估值升至45倍，上漲空間也僅約18%至19%；反之，若蘋果相對大盤的估值溢價，由目前約100%縮減至50%，本益比將降至不到28倍，對應股價可能回落近27%。這是估值變動的情境推算，並非他提出的確定跌幅預測。
儘管股票估值偏高，Khouw指出，蘋果選擇權價格相對大盤仍便宜。
整體市場隱含波動率約位於歷史第93百分位，但蘋果隱含波動率卻略低於過去一年平均；指數選擇權相對蘋果選擇權的價格，也處於第98百分位。
在他看來，股票估值偏高、選擇權相對便宜的組合，提供了重新評估避險部位的時機。
策略上，Khouw提出買進賣權價差，也就是買進一口價平或略為價外的賣權，同時賣出一口相同到期日、履約價更低的賣權。透過收取賣出賣權的權利金，可降低整體支出，也能部分抵銷時間價值耗損的影響，但下跌保護或獲利空間會受到限制。
此外，較深度價外的賣權通常具有較高隱含波動率，交易者可利用這種波動率偏斜，透過賣出較低履約價的賣權，補貼買進賣權的成本。
Khouw的核心看法是，蘋果享有的高溢價，建立在投資人相信它能抵禦其他科技股所面臨風險的基礎上。服務中斷則提醒市場，蘋果同樣存在營運弱點；當股價已反映高度樂觀預期，這些風險更值得納入評估。
輝達股價週三(18日) 震盪翻黑，終場下跌2.89%，收在每股150.96美元，自宣布黃仁勳請辭以來，5個交易日累計下跌13.11%。蘋果(AAPL-US) 升0.15%至每股352.45美元，黃仁勳請辭以來，累計下跌0.89%。

items.title: 法國砍最兇！全球資金逃離美債 9月持倉銳減755億美元 「這一國」卻創近半世紀最大買超紀錄
items.title_en: France Cuts the Most! Global Funds Flee U.S. Treasuries, September Holdings Drop by $75.5 Billion – One Country Sets a Near‑Half‑Century Record Purchase
paras: 最新數據顯示，全球資金對美債的態度在9月出現罕見分化。海外投資人持有美債規模較8月減少755億美元至9.24兆美元，創今年3月以來最大單月降幅紀錄，也是一年來最低水平，日英中三大「債主」罕見同步減持，南韓逆勢創記錄買進115億美元。需留意的是，持倉餘額下降不全是「拋售」。
美債9月遭遇新一輪拋售，彭博美債指數單月下跌2.2%，價格估值拖累明顯；按交易流量計算，海外投資者當月仍淨買超美債808億美元，只是買盤力度較8月縮水近26%。
根據美國財政部最新TIC數據，日本作為美債最大海外持有國，減持52億美元至1.063兆美元，創2024年底以來新低。市場解讀與夏季日元走弱、日本干預匯市、變賣美債籌資有關。英國減持87億美元至約9860億美元，結束連兩月創新高走勢。中國減持近270億美元至約5640億美元，續創2008年以來低點，法國減持規模更高達314億美元，為前十大持有國或地區之最。
增持則集中在比利時、加拿大與開曼群島；比利時加碼174億美元至5079億美元，市場普遍認為其中含中國透過託管帳戶持有的部位；加拿大增加31億美元。
最搶眼的是韓國。南韓投資人9月淨買入美債115億美元，創美國財政部1977年有數據以來最高紀錄，與今年上半年七個月淨賣出、2月創單月拋售紀錄形成強烈反差，同期還淨買入美股102億美元，押注AI科技股反彈。
整體來看，9月美債殖利率因升息預期與通膨韌性大幅衝高，10年期一度突破5.3%，外資一邊壓低長債殖利率、一邊在回檔中分批布局。持有水位背後，是匯率干預、託管通道、估值波動與國別偏好交織的一場全球資金再配置。
paras_en: The latest data show that global funds' attitude toward U.S. Treasuries diverged sharply in September. Overseas investors' holdings fell by $75.5 billion from August to $9.24 trillion, marking the biggest monthly decline since March this year and the lowest level in a year. The three major "bondholders" – Japan, the United Kingdom and China – unusually reduced their positions simultaneously, while South Korea bucked the trend with a record purchase of $11.5 billion. It should be noted that the drop in holdings is not entirely due to "selling".

U.S. Treasuries faced a new round of selling in September, with Bloomberg's Treasury Index down 2.2% for the month, reflecting a clear price‑valuation drag. Yet, based on transaction flow, overseas investors still net‑bought $80.8 billion of Treasuries in the month, although buying pressure shrank by about 26% compared with August.

According to the U.S. Treasury's latest TIC data, Japan – the largest foreign holder of U.S. Treasuries – reduced its stake by $5.2 billion to $1.063 trillion, a new low since the end of 2024. Markets link this to the summer yen weakness, Japanese FX intervention and the sale of Treasuries to raise funds. The United Kingdom cut $8.7 billion to about $986 billion, ending a two‑month streak of record‑high holdings. China trimmed nearly $27 billion to roughly $564 billion, a low not seen since 2008, while France’s reduction was even larger at $31.4 billion, the biggest among the top ten holder countries or regions.

Increases were concentrated in Belgium, Canada and the Cayman Islands; Belgium added $17.4 billion to reach $507.9 billion, with the market broadly assuming that part of the increase reflects positions held by China through custodial accounts. Canada raised its holdings by $3.1 billion.

The most striking case is South Korea. Korean investors net‑bought $11.5 billion of U.S. Treasuries in September, the highest monthly net purchase on record since the Treasury began keeping data in 1977, a stark contrast to the net sales over the first seven months of this year and the record‑setting monthly sell‑off in February. At the same time they also net‑bought $10.2 billion of U.S. equities, betting on a rebound in AI‑related stocks.

Overall, September Treasury yields surged sharply due to rate‑hike expectations and stubborn inflation, with the 10‑year yield briefly breaking 5.3%. Foreign investors pushed long‑term yields lower while gradually re‑entering on the pullback. Behind the holding levels lies a global capital reallocation driven by currency interventions, custodial channels, valuation swings and country‑specific preferences.

items.title: 英特爾18A-P拿下首家外部客戶！分析師：晶圓代工重大勝利
items.title_en: Intel Secures First External Customer for 18A-P Process—Analysts Call It a Major Win for Wafer‑Foundry Business
paras: 英特爾(INTC-US)先進製程代工業務迎來重要突破。執行長陳立武週三(18日)表示，公司已簽下首家18A系列製程外部客戶，但未透露客戶名稱。英特爾技術長隨後證實，客戶採用的是18A-P製程，為這家晶片大廠歷時五年、力圖挑戰台積電的晶圓代工布局，跨出關鍵一步。
陳立武在德州奧斯汀舉行的TomorrowX Summit上表示，晶圓代工供應的韌性非常重要，並透露：「18A方面，我正參與生產相關工作，而我們剛剛簽下第一家客戶。」
英特爾技術長Pushkar Ranade隨後於社群平台X進一步說明，這家外部客戶簽約採用的是18A-P製程。該製程已於今年6月進入風險試產階段。
Intel 18A-P 是英特爾在 Intel 18A 製程基礎上的強化版本，主要針對高效能運算與外部晶圓代工客戶進行效能、功耗與散熱最佳化
這項進展對英特爾轉型具有指標意義。
過去幾年，英特爾先進製程發展歷經延誤與良率問題，公司將18A視為重振競爭力的核心，希望藉此擴大承接外部晶片設計公司的訂單，降低晶圓廠以生產自家產品為主的依賴。
Creative Strategies分析師Ben Bajarin接受訪問時表示：「這對晶圓代工業務而言，是一場重大勝利。」
對於首家客戶可能是誰，Bajarin點名輝達、蘋果，以及自行開發客製化處理器的大型雲端業者。不過，這些均屬他的推測，英特爾尚未公布客戶身分。
Bajarin指出：「亞馬遜、微軟和Google都難以在台積電取得足夠產能，以實現各自的CPU布局。因此，轉向其他地方取得至少部分產能，是合理的做法。」
今年5月已有報導指出，蘋果與英特爾接近達成協議，可能由英特爾代工部分蘋果裝置所需晶片。不過，這次公布的18A-P客戶是否為蘋果，仍有待確認。
從產業角度來看，首家外部客戶簽約，代表英特爾先進製程開始取得商業驗證，也讓尋求分散供應來源的晶片設計業者多了一項選擇。不過，英特爾尚未揭露訂單規模、量產時程及營收貢獻，這項突破能否進一步轉化為穩定的大量生產與持續訂單，仍是後續觀察重點。
陳立武另於10月下旬表示，預期全球伺服器處理器市場未來五年規模最高可增至目前的五倍，達到約2,000億美元，但英特爾現階段仍無法完全滿足客戶需求。
除了先進製程，英特爾也在先進封裝業務公布新進展。陳立武週三宣布，微軟成為公司最先進EMIB封裝技術首家公開具名的客戶。這類技術可將多顆晶片整合、互連，再與更大的系統連接，是英特爾爭取外部客戶的另一項競爭籌碼。
此次利多出爐之際，英特爾正面臨股價與營運壓力。
自9月底以來，公司股價已下跌逾五成，主要跌勢集中於10月下旬，當時英特爾表示，受到個人電腦銷售疲弱及供應鏈挑戰影響，本季營收預估將較分析師預期至少短少10億美元。
英特爾自去年年中起，一度因美國本土晶片製造題材受到市場追捧。
美國政府於2025年8月取得英特爾約10%股權，輝達其後也宣布投資50億美元，帶動投資人期待英特爾能承接更多美國製造需求。
如今，18A-P首家外部客戶與微軟封裝合作，為英特爾代工轉型提供新的進展，但能否藉此改善營運表現，仍取決於後續量產執行與訂單擴張。
英特爾(INTC-US)週三(18日)下跌0.91%，收54.67美元，連續第五個交易日收黑。
paras_en: Intel’s (INTC-US) advanced process foundry business has reached a significant breakthrough. CEO Chen Lifu announced on Wednesday (18th) that the company has signed its first external customer for the 18A series, though the customer’s name was not disclosed. Intel’s CTO later confirmed that the customer is using the 18A‑P process, a version that has taken five years to develop and is aimed at challenging TSMC’s wafer‑foundry footprint, marking a critical step forward for the chip giant.

At the TomorrowX Summit in Austin, Texas, Chen Lifu emphasized the importance of resilience in wafer‑foundry supply and said, “Regarding 18A, I am involved in production work, and we have just signed our first customer.”
Intel CTO Pushkar Ranade further clarified on X that the external customer has signed up for the 18A‑P process, which entered risk‑trial production in June of this year.

The Intel 18A‑P is an enhanced version of Intel’s 18A process, primarily optimized for high‑performance computing and external wafer‑foundry customers in terms of performance, power consumption, and heat dissipation.
This development is a benchmark for Intel’s transformation.

Over the past few years, Intel’s advanced process development has faced delays and yield issues. The company views 18A as the core to revitalize competitiveness, hoping to expand orders from external chip‑design firms and reduce reliance on its own wafer plants for internal production.
Creative Strategies analyst Ben Bajarin said in an interview that this is a major win for the wafer‑foundry business.

When asked who the first customer might be, Bajarin named Nvidia, Apple, and large cloud operators that develop custom processors. However, these are only his speculations; Intel has not yet announced the customer’s identity.

Bajarin pointed out that Amazon, Microsoft, and Google struggle to secure enough capacity at TSMC to meet their CPU plans, so turning to other sources for at least part of the capacity is a reasonable approach.

In May, reports indicated that Apple and Intel were close to an agreement that could see Intel fabbing some chips for Apple devices. Whether the newly announced 18A‑P customer is Apple remains to be confirmed.

From an industry perspective, the first external customer signing represents commercial validation of Intel’s advanced process and gives chip designers seeking supply diversification another option. However, Intel has not disclosed order size, mass‑production timelines, or revenue contribution, so whether this breakthrough translates into stable, large‑scale production and ongoing orders remains a key point of observation.

Chen Lifu also said in late October that the global server‑processor market could grow up to five times its current size over the next five years, reaching about $200 billion, but Intel is still unable to fully meet customer demand at present.

In addition to advanced processes, Intel announced new progress in advanced packaging. Chen Lifu said on Wednesday that Microsoft became the first publicly named customer for Intel’s most advanced EMIB packaging technology. This technology integrates multiple chips, interconnects them, and connects to larger systems, providing another competitive chip for Intel’s external customer pursuit.
Amid this positive news, Intel is facing pressure on its stock price and operations.

Since the end of September, the company’s stock has fallen more than 50%, with the main decline occurring in late October when Intel said that weak PC sales and supply‑chain challenges would cut this quarter’s revenue forecast by at least $1 billion below analyst expectations.
Since mid‑last year, Intel has been briefly favored by the market due to domestic U.S. chip‑manufacturing themes.

In August 2025, the U.S. government acquired about 10% of Intel’s shares, and Nvidia subsequently announced a $5 billion investment, fueling investor expectations that Intel could take on more U.S. manufacturing demand.

Today, the first external customer for 18A‑P and the Microsoft packaging collaboration provide new progress for Intel’s foundry transformation, but whether this improves operating performance depends on subsequent mass‑production execution and order expansion.
Intel (INTC-US) fell 0.91% on Wednesday (18th) to $54.67, marking its fifth consecutive trading day in the red.

items.title: 6萬員工獲自願離職資格！微軟執行長：AI倒逼組織重構  不可能「一切照舊」
items.title_en: 6 Million Employees Eligible for Voluntary Exit; Microsoft CEO: AI Forces Organizational Restructuring, No "Business as Usual"
paras: 微軟執行長納德拉周一(16日)接受《The Pragmatic Engineer》播客採訪時坦言，隨著AI改變軟體開發模式，微軟內部崗位職責、團隊規模與組織結構都將重塑，「我也希望告訴大家一切會保持原樣，但我做不到」。
他表示，微軟希望超過20萬名員工繼續成長，但必須以不同方式重新配置人才。他直言，公司內部並非所有團隊都已適應AI轉型，不希望員工「困在沒有完成轉型的團隊裡」；若職業發展受限，可離開原團隊，但他更期待員工在微軟內部找到新機會。
這番表態對應微軟10月26日推出的自願離職計畫(VEO)：面向美、加、英、印部分團隊中70級及以下合資格員工，提供經濟補助與職涯支持，6萬人符合申請條件，預計實際接受比例低於5%，即不足3000人。微軟強調，VEO目的不是大規模逼退，而是「讓合適的人進入合適的崗位」。
VEO背後，是AI已滲入微軟生產流程。納德拉曾透露，AI生成代碼已佔微軟代碼總量20%至30%，驗證與重構能力比純寫碼更關鍵。當代碼生成變便宜，組織自然要向AI基礎設施、前向部署工程、模型驗證等新型崗位傾斜。
這次訪談由微軟前工程師Gergely Orosz主持。面對VEO是否預示AI相關裁員的問題，納德拉強調，微軟希望給予員工更多自主權，讓他們能夠進入符合自身長期職涯發展和經濟利益的職位。
納德拉也提到，系統工程師、基礎設施人員及AI訓練研究人員等職位的薪酬正大幅上漲。微軟希望透過相關安排，讓員工有更多機會轉向這些需求成長的領域。他同時表示，前向部署工程師(FDE)是微軟目前成長最快的職位之一。
paras_en: Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella told The Pragmatic Engineer podcast on Monday (the 16th) that as AI reshapes software development, Microsoft’s internal job responsibilities, team sizes and organizational structure will be rebuilt. “I wish I could tell everyone everything will stay the same, but I can’t,” he said.

He said Microsoft wants more than 200,000 employees to keep growing, but talent will have to be re‑allocated in different ways. Not every team inside the company has adapted to the AI transformation, and he does not want staff “stuck in teams that haven’t completed the transition.” If career growth is limited, employees may leave their current team, though he hopes they will find new opportunities within Microsoft.

The comment coincides with Microsoft’s Voluntary Exit Offer (VEO) launched on Oct. 26, which targets eligible employees at level 70 or below in certain teams in the U.S., Canada, the U.K. and India. About 60,000 people meet the criteria, and Microsoft expects fewer than 5 %—under 3,000—to actually take the offer. Microsoft stresses the VEO is not a mass layoff but a way to “put the right people in the right roles.”

Behind the VEO is the fact that AI has already permeated Microsoft’s production processes. Nadella disclosed that AI‑generated code now accounts for roughly 20‑30 % of Microsoft’s total code, and that verification and refactoring are becoming more critical than pure coding. As code generation gets cheaper, the organization naturally shifts toward new roles such as AI infrastructure, forward‑deployment engineering and model validation.

The interview was hosted by former Microsoft engineer Gergely Orosz. When asked whether the VEO signals AI‑related layoffs, Nadella emphasized that Microsoft wants to give employees more autonomy so they can move into positions that align with their long‑term career goals and financial interests.

Nadella also noted that salaries for system engineers, infrastructure staff and AI‑training researchers are rising sharply. Microsoft hopes its initiatives will give employees more chances to transition into these high‑growth areas, and he added that forward‑deployment engineers (FDEs) are currently one of the fastest‑growing roles at the company.

items.title: 川習三會前全力降溫！川普盛讚與習近平友誼深厚 黃仁勳事件僅「簡短提及」
items.title_en: Trump Prepares to Cool Tensions Before Three-Person Summit, Praises Friendship with Xi, Mentions Jensen Only Briefly
paras: 美國總統川普周四(19日)出席中國深圳舉行的亞太經濟合作會議(APEC)高峰會，他受訪時盛讚自己與中國國家主席習近平的「友誼」深厚，並淡化涉及輝達(NVDA-US)的間諜風暴，試圖在「川習三會」登場幾小時前，降低這起事件對雙邊關係的影響。
川普周四接受《福斯新聞》(Fox News)訪問時，談到周三晚宴的狀況，他說：「我昨晚整晚都和習主席在一起，晚宴時就坐在他旁邊，正好在他的右手邊，我們整個晚上都在交談，也談到了人工智慧(AI)。」
被問到是否曾在晚宴上與習近平談到輝達共同創辦人黃仁勳下台一事時，川普表示：「我可能只是簡短提到過，因為這實在是一場悲劇。」黃仁勳一直是反對限制對中國出售晶片的重要人物。
川普預定周四稍晚將與習近平舉行今年第三次峰會，目前美中貿易休戰協議預定明年1月10日到期，而輝達間諜風暴的後續發展，可能打亂原本脆弱的休戰局面。
美國本周稍早祭出新的晶片限制措施，旨在阻止北京訓練最先進AI模型的能力。北京則警告，若雙方無法達成解決方案，中國將採取反制措施。

習近平罕見親自接機 川普淡化輝達間諜疑雲

儘管雙邊關係存在潛在緊張情勢，習近平周三仍親自前往機場迎接川普，回報川普去年9月在華盛頓親自接待中國領導人的禮遇。這是中國領導人約50年來首次在停機坪迎接到訪的外國貴賓。
川普盛讚中方的接待安排，同時試圖淡化有關黃仁勳與一名Megaspeed女性主管黃樂(Alice Huang)發生婚外情的報導。美國情報機構認為，該名女性可能為中國從事間諜活動。
川普對《福斯新聞》說：「任何來自中國的漂亮女性，他們都會把她視為間諜。」他說：「她是一名商人，買過晶片。」
當被問及這段婚外情是否構成國家安全威脅時，川普說：「我沒有聽說過這件事。」川普還進一步說：「我沒有聽說她是間諜。」
川普與習近平周四下午也預定與俄羅斯領導人普丁(Vladimir Putin)會面。若這場會面成行，將是三人首度舉行的峰會，三人所代表的國家合計掌握全球至少90%的核武器。
paras_en: On Thursday (19th), U.S. President Donald Trump attended the APEC summit in Shenzhen, China, where he praised the deep friendship he shares with Chinese President Xi Jinping and downplayed the Nvidia espionage scandal, aiming to lessen its impact on bilateral relations a few hours before the "Trump‑Xi‑Putin" summit.

During a Fox News interview on Thursday, Trump discussed the Wednesday evening banquet, saying, "I spent the whole night with President Xi, sitting right beside him on his right side, and we talked all night, including about artificial intelligence (AI)."

When asked if he had discussed Nvidia co‑founder Jensen Huang's resignation at the banquet, Trump replied, "I may have mentioned it briefly, because it is truly a tragedy." Huang has long opposed restrictions on chip sales to China.

Trump is scheduled to hold the third summit with Xi later on Thursday. The U.S.–China trade truce is set to expire on January 10 next year, and further developments in the Nvidia espionage case could disrupt the fragile truce.

Earlier this week, the U.S. introduced new chip restrictions aimed at preventing Beijing from training advanced AI models. Beijing warned that if no solution is reached, China would take countermeasures.

Xi personally picked up Trump at the airport on Wednesday, a rare gesture that mirrored the hospitality Trump received in Washington last September. It was the first time in about 50 years that a Chinese leader greeted a foreign dignitary on the tarmac.

Trump praised China's reception arrangements while attempting to downplay reports of a romantic affair between Jensen Huang and a Megaspeed female executive named Alice Huang. U.S. intelligence believes the woman may be a Chinese spy.
Trump told Fox News, "Any pretty woman from China, they treat her as a spy." He added, "She is a businesswoman who has bought chips."
When asked if the affair posed a national security threat, Trump said, "I have not heard of that." He further added, "I have not heard that she is a spy."

Later on Thursday, Trump and Xi are also scheduled to meet Russian President Vladimir Putin. If the meeting takes place, it will be the first summit of the three, and the three countries together control at least 90% of the world’s nuclear arsenal.

items.title: 伊朗再襲美軍基地 戰火蔓延至科威特、巴林
items.title_en: Iran Strikes US Bases Again, Conflict Spreads to Kuwait and Bahrain
paras: 美伊衝突再度升級，繼美軍空襲伊朗荷姆茲海峽附近軍事設施後，伊朗對波斯灣地區發起新一輪襲擊，科威特境內美軍基地和巴林接連淪為目標。
伊朗軍方18日（周三）宣布，對科威特境內阿里·薩利姆空軍基地發動襲擊，目標包括美軍無人機和飛彈設施。
科威特軍方證實，防空系統當天攔截來襲無人機，但尚未通報具體損失。科威特外交部隨後譴責伊朗，強調將採取必要措施，維護國家安全。
與此同時，巴林內政部18日凌晨兩度發布警報，要求民眾就地避險。巴林軍方隨後宣布，防空系統成功攔截來自伊朗的空中襲擊。這也是巴林一周內第三次遭伊朗襲擊。
巴林是美國海軍第五艦隊司令部所在地。近期伊朗多次針對當地美軍設施發動無人機襲擊。
新一輪交火發生前一天，美軍戰機空襲伊朗南部格什姆島一處飛彈發射設施。美方稱，此舉是為回應伊朗此前針對美國人員及軍事據點的襲擊。
paras_en: The US‑Iran clash escalated again: after a US airstrike on Iranian military facilities near the Strait of Hormuz, Iran launched a new round of attacks in the Persian Gulf region, targeting US bases in Kuwait and Bahrain.
Iran’s armed forces announced on Wednesday the 18th that they had attacked the Ali Al‑Salim Air Base in Kuwait, striking US drones and missile installations.

Kuwait’s military confirmed its air‑defence systems intercepted the incoming drones that day, though it has not reported specific damage. The Kuwaiti foreign ministry subsequently condemned Iran and said it would take necessary measures to safeguard national security.

At the same time, Bahrain’s interior ministry issued two alerts in the early hours of the 18th, urging residents to seek shelter. The Bahraini military later said its air‑defence systems successfully intercepted the aerial attack from Iran, marking the third Iranian strike on Bahrain within a week.
Bahrain hosts the US Navy’s Fifth Fleet headquarters, and Iran has recently carried out multiple drone attacks on US facilities there.

The day before the new round of fighting, US warplanes bombed a missile‑launch site on Iran’s southern Qeshm Island. The US said the strike was a response to earlier Iranian attacks on American personnel and military sites.

items.title: AI不只餵飽輝達！WSTS：全球前20大晶片商Q3全員成長　SK海力士季增49%居冠、鎧俠緊追
items.title_en: AI Not Just Feeding Nvidia! WSTS: Global Top 20 Chipmakers All Grow in Q3 – SK Hynix Leads with 49% Quarterly Increase, TSMC Close Behind
paras: 根據世界半導體協會(WSTS)最新數據，今年Q3全球半導體市場規模季增27%至4810億美元，年增129%，創下WSTS有史以來最高年增率紀錄，超越第二季110%的紀錄。
數據顯示，AI繼續主導市場增長，輝達當季營收季增20%；三星、SK海力士、美光、鎧俠、閃迪等記憶體廠商受AI驅動，整體營收季增36%。全球前20大供應商營收全數呈季增表現，其中SK海力士(49%)與鎧俠(40%)增幅最為亮眼。
展望第四季，14家給出指引的公司中10家預計增長。超微受資料中心需求推升，預估季增27%；聯發科受AI加速器拉動，預計增29%，輝達增速則從20%放緩至12%，英特爾因PC市場疲軟料將下滑6.1%，Skyworks受智慧手機拖累降6.7%，並在完成與Qorvo合併後首度擠進前二十，安森美則因此跌出榜單，德儀與英飛凌預計分別微降0.1%和2.3%。
今年前三季全球半導體市場規模年增104%，全年規模至少是2025年的兩倍，增速為60多年來首見，各家預測落在110%至112%區間。
至於2027年，機構預測則呈較大分歧：RCD Advisors看23%，半導體情報機構則看60%甚至上看80%。該機構基本假設AI維持強勁但增速放緩，汽車與工業市場健康，記憶體短缺緩解後PC與手機市場復甦。
業界人士指出，當前AI驅動的榮景已超越PC、網際網路與智慧手機時代，正經歷半導體史無前例的黃金時期。
paras_en: According to the latest data from the World Semiconductor Trade Statistics (WSTS), the global semiconductor market size grew 27% quarter‑on‑quarter to $481 billion in Q3, and 129% year‑on‑year, setting a new WSTS record for the highest annual growth rate and surpassing the 110% record of Q2.

The data shows AI continues to drive market growth, with Nvidia’s revenue up 20% quarter‑on‑quarter; Samsung, SK Hynix, Micron, TSMC, and SK Hynix’s memory rivals all saw AI‑driven revenue rise 36% quarter‑on‑quarter. All of the top 20 suppliers posted quarter‑on‑quarter growth, with SK Hynix (49%) and TSMC (40%) delivering the most impressive gains.

Looking ahead to Q4, 10 of the 14 companies that issued guidance expect growth. Intel’s data‑center demand is expected to lift revenue 27% quarter‑on‑quarter; MediaTek, driven by AI accelerators, is forecast to grow 29%; Nvidia’s growth is expected to slow from 20% to 12%; Intel is projected to decline 6.1% due to a weak PC market; Skyworks, dragged down by smartphones, is expected to fall 6.7%; after completing its merger with Qorvo, Skyworks entered the top 20 for the first time, pushing Ansys out of the list; and Analog Devices and Infineon are expected to see slight declines of 0.1% and 2.3% respectively.

For the first three quarters of this year, the global semiconductor market grew 104% year‑on‑year, and the full‑year size is projected to be at least twice that of 2025, with a growth rate that has not been seen in over 60 years. Forecasts for the full year range between 110% and 112%.

Regarding 2027, forecasts diverge significantly: RCD Advisors projects 23%, while semiconductor intelligence firms see 60% or even up to 80%. These firms assume AI will remain strong but at a slower pace, automotive and industrial markets will stay healthy, and after memory shortages ease, PC and smartphone markets will recover.
Industry experts note that the current AI‑driven boom has surpassed the PC, internet, and smartphone eras, and the semiconductor industry is experiencing an unprecedented golden age.

items.title: 黃仁勳重返輝達有解？持股3.58%握董事提名權 尚未表態出招
items.title_en: Could Jensen Huang Return to Nvidia? Holds 3.58% Shares and Nomination Rights, No Decision Yet
paras: 黃仁勳雖已辭去輝達(NVDA-US)執行長職務，但仍可能透過股東身分影響公司未來。《Investing.com》週三(18日)報導，輝達的股東董事提名制度，允許符合持股比例與年限要求的股東，將董事候選人納入公司正式委託書資料。持有約3.58%股份的黃仁勳，似乎符合相關持股門檻，可能藉此爭取董事會重新考慮讓他回歸。
不過，黃仁勳尚未公開表示打算動用這項權利挑戰董事會。提名董事也不代表能取得董事會控制權，更不等於股東可以直接表決讓他重任執行長。
報導指出，依據輝達的委託書提名權(proxy access)規定，連續三年持有至少3%表決權的股東，可提名最多兩名董事候選人，並將其納入公司正式委託書資料，交由股東投票。
黃仁勳及其相關實體持股超過門檻的時間已逾三年，因此看來符合行使這項權利的持股要求，但仍須遵守其他適用規定，候選人也必須符合輝達的獨立性及其他公司治理要求。
這項制度的重要性，在於董事會掌握執行長任命權。如果黃仁勳提名的兩名候選人獲得股東支持、成功當選，便可能在董事會內增加認同其經營方向的聲音，進而影響領導交接等決策，包括重新討論他的去留。
然而，即使兩名候選人全數當選，也不會自動讓黃仁勳掌控董事會。任何改變董事會立場的行動，仍須爭取其他董事支持，並面對股東投票與公司治理規範等挑戰。
黃仁勳11月17日發表聲明，承認自己在私生活上犯下嚴重錯誤，並為造成董事會困擾承擔責任，同時承諾配合獨立調查。他也表示，若董事會認為他的回歸符合股東、員工、公司與美國的最佳利益，他將「很榮幸」重新擔任執行長。
這番表態保留了回歸空間，也顯示他目前仍將決定權交給董事會，尚未公開採取對抗行動。
但輝達管理層的公開立場依然明確。代理執行長克瑞斯(Colette Kress)接受CNBC主持人克萊默(Jim Cramer)訪問時表示：「董事會已決定，不會讓黃仁勳復職。」
她也在公司上調營收展望的法說會尾聲，以「我們能應付」(we got this)為團隊打氣。
另一方面，要求黃仁勳回歸的聲浪持續擴大。
Altimeter Capital執行長 Brad Gerstner 已公開主張讓他復職；Semafor則報導，董事會內部有一派支持他回歸。
一份呼籲輝達恢復黃仁勳職務的網路連署，也已吸引約20萬人簽名，支持者包括馬斯克(Elon Musk)、Y Combinator執行長譚恩(Garry Tan)，以及Epic Games執行長史威尼(Tim Sweeney)。
美國總統川普亦表示，對黃仁勳重返輝達持開放態度。
避險基金大亨、潘興廣場(Pershing Square)執行長艾克曼(Bill Ackman)週三進一步批評，他不認為輝達董事會的處置符合股東最佳利益，也質疑其是否符合董事應負的受託義務。
這些說法屬於艾克曼的公開主張，並非董事會違反義務的法律認定。
目前，董事提名權仍只是黃仁勳可能運用的途徑，尚未成為已公布的行動計畫。
若雙方無法透過協商達成共識，他能否藉由股東支持增加對董事會的影響力，將取決於提名資格、候選人條件、股東投票結果，以及董事會內部的支持程度。
paras_en: Jensen Huang has resigned as Nvidia (NVDA-US) CEO, but he may still influence the company’s future as a shareholder. According to an Investing.com report on Wednesday (18th), Nvidia’s shareholder director nomination system allows shareholders who meet share‑holding and tenure requirements to include director candidates in the company’s formal proxy materials. With about 3.58% of the shares, Huang appears to meet the relevant threshold and could use this to push the board to reconsider his return.

However, Huang has not publicly stated that he intends to exercise this right to challenge the board. Nomination of directors does not guarantee control of the board, nor does it mean shareholders can directly vote him back as CEO.

The report notes that under Nvidia’s proxy‑access rules, shareholders who hold at least 3% voting power for three consecutive years may nominate up to two director candidates and include them in the official proxy materials for shareholder voting.

Huang and his related entities have held shares above the threshold for more than three years, so he seems to meet the holding requirement for exercising this right, but he must still comply with other applicable rules and the candidates must satisfy Nvidia’s independence and other corporate‑governance requirements.

The importance of this system lies in the board’s control over CEO appointments. If the two candidates nominated by Huang receive shareholder support and are elected, they could add voices that align with his management direction, thereby influencing leadership transitions and decisions such as reconsidering his tenure.

Even if both candidates are elected, it would not automatically give Huang control of the board. Any change in the board’s stance would still require support from other directors and face shareholder voting and corporate‑governance challenges.

On November 17, Huang issued a statement admitting serious personal mistakes, taking responsibility for the board’s troubles, and pledging to cooperate with an independent investigation. He also said that if the board believes his return is in the best interests of shareholders, employees, the company, and the United States, he would be "honored" to resume the CEO role.
This statement leaves room for a return and shows that he currently hands decision power to the board, without publicly taking confrontational action.
Nevertheless, Nvidia’s management remains clear in its stance. Acting CEO Colette Kress told CNBC’s Jim Cramer that the board has decided not to allow Huang to return.
She also encouraged the team at the end of a earnings‑forecast call with the phrase, "we got this."
Meanwhile, calls for Huang’s return continue to grow.
Altimeter Capital CEO Brad Gerstner has publicly advocated for his reinstatement; Semafor reported that a faction within the board supports his return.
A petition calling for Nvidia to restore Huang’s position has gathered about 200,000 signatures, including supporters such as Elon Musk, Y Combinator CEO Garry Tan, and Epic Games CEO Tim Sweeney.
U.S. President Trump also expressed an open attitude toward Huang’s return to Nvidia.
Pershing Square CEO Bill Ackman further criticized on Wednesday, saying he does not believe the board’s handling is in shareholders’ best interests and questioned whether it meets fiduciary duties.
These statements are Ackman’s public positions and not a legal determination that the board has breached its duties.
Currently, the nomination right remains a potential avenue for Huang, but it has not become a publicly announced plan.

If the parties cannot reach a consensus through negotiation, whether he can increase his influence on the board through shareholder support will depend on nomination eligibility, candidate qualifications, shareholder voting outcomes, and the level of internal board support.

items.title: 以色列在加薩發起地面攻擊 2025年停火協議以來首次
items.title_en: Israel Launches Ground Attack in Gaza, First Since 2025 Ceasefire Agreement
paras: 以色列地面部隊18日（周三）越過停火分界線，推進至哈瑪斯控制的加薩地帶中部地區，這是自2025年底美國斡旋達成停火協議以來，以軍首次發動地面突襲。
《路透社》援引目擊者說法，稱部分以軍坦克當天駛入停火分界線「黃線」以西主幹道薩拉赫丁路。目前以色列仍控制「黃線」一側約三分之二加薩領土。
巴勒斯坦媒體和社交媒體發布的影片顯示，當地槍炮聲密集，大批巴勒斯坦家庭被迫逃離努塞拉特難民營周邊地區。
一名當地居民對《BBC》阿拉伯語頻道說：「現在情況極其糟糕，以色列軍隊對流離失所者尋求庇護的地區進行無差別射擊。」
以色列軍方隨後證實聯合情報機關辛貝特展開這次行動，目標為打擊非控制區內哈瑪斯基礎設施。以軍稱，部隊攜帶工程機械進入黃線以西，旨在摧毀一條對以軍構成直接威脅的哈瑪斯隧道。
以軍表示，此次突襲規模有限，暗示不存在大規模進攻，但沒有提供襲擊目標或行動將持續多久的細節。
哈瑪斯則發表聲明，警告以軍越界、強迫居民遷離是「危險事態」。哈瑪斯指責以色列看守政府為轉嫁國內危機，蓄意破壞由美國斡旋達成的停火協議，並敦促國際調解人立即介入。
paras_en: Israeli ground forces crossed the ceasefire line on the 18th (Wednesday) and advanced into the central Gaza Strip under Hamas control, marking the first ground assault by the Israeli military since the ceasefire agreement brokered by the United States at the end of 2025.

According to Reuters citing eyewitnesses, some Israeli tanks entered the west side of the ceasefire line, the “yellow line,” on the main road, Salah al-Din Road. Israel currently controls about two‑thirds of Gaza on the yellow line side.
Videos posted by Palestinian media and social media show heavy gunfire and large numbers of Palestinian families forced to flee the area around the Nuseirat refugee camp.
A local resident told BBC Arabic that the situation is “extremely bad” and that Israeli troops are indiscriminately shooting at areas where displaced people are seeking shelter.

The Israeli military later confirmed that the joint intelligence agency, the SIB, launched the operation, targeting Hamas infrastructure in the uncontrolled area. The troops brought engineering equipment west of the yellow line to destroy a Hamas tunnel that posed a direct threat to Israeli forces.
The Israeli military said the raid was limited in scale, implying no large‑scale offensive, but did not provide details on the target or how long the operation would last.

Hamas issued a statement warning that the Israeli incursion and forced displacement of residents constituted a “dangerous situation.” Hamas accused the Israeli government of diverting domestic crises, deliberately undermining the ceasefire agreement brokered by the United States, and urged international mediators to intervene immediately.

items.title: 川普：未來2、3年可開放輝達Blackwell晶片賣到中國 屆時將有更新產品取代
paras: 美國總統川普周四(19日)表示，未來可能允許輝達(NVDA-US)向中國出售備受市場追捧的Blackwell晶片，但前提是該晶片屆時已不再是市場上最先進的產品。
川普正在中國深圳參加亞太經濟合作會議(APEC)峰會，他周四接受福斯新聞(Fox News)專訪時說：「兩年或三年後，如果我還在任，我會說，好吧，你們現在可以出售Blackwell晶片了，因為屆時他們會有其他產品。」
他補充說：「你們知道，他們已經在研發其他產品，將取代Blackwell晶片。但兩、三年後，我會說，就去賣Blackwell吧，因為屆時他們已經有能力做到這一點。」川普的總統任期將於2029年1月結束。

輝達晶片銷中成APEC焦點 

中國從何種管道取得人工智慧(AI)晶片，已成為此次峰會的重要爭議點。輝達執行長黃仁勳因涉及企業治理和國安疑慮的婚外情上周突然離任，其中一名外遇對象正在接受美國政府調查，調查方向包括這名女性是否與中國間諜機構合作，以及是否協助走私晶片。
川普政府本周稍早採取行動，加強對輸往多個國家的處理器出口審查，試圖限制中國企業從遠端取得AI晶片及伺服器的管道。輝達的Blackwell晶片是美中科技競爭的核心之一，其運算能力將大幅提升北京快速發展AI技術的能力。
黃仁勳領導下的輝達一直遊說美國政府批准向中國出售Blackwell晶片，但川普政府始終未同意這項要求，僅允許輝達出售技術較落後的H200處理器。
川普在福斯新聞專訪中說：「你看，我們當時允許出售的，只有那些舊款產品，也就是某種程度上已經半淘汰的晶片。他們甚至沒有賣出多少H200，而H200現在也已經過時。Blackwell則非常先進，是相當新穎的產品。再過一年，它們也會過時。」

美國收緊出口管制、推動AI監督法案

美國國會議員正在推動國會至少未來18個月內禁止輝達向中國出售Blackwell晶片，而川普的最新談話可能讓他們稍感放心。
印第安納州共和黨籍參議員Jim Banks與麻薩諸塞州民主黨籍參議員華倫(Elizabeth Warren)成功推動《AI監督法案》(AI Overwatch Act)，目前已進入年度國防支出法案的最後協商階段。按照過往經驗，通常能在12月通過。

items.title: 蘋果真如投資人所想 是AI投資避風港嗎？
paras: 蘋果(AAPL-US)近期成為科技股資金避風港，但接近37倍的預估本益比，可能已使股價缺乏容錯空間。《CNBC》撰稿人暨選擇權分析師Michael Khouw週三(18日)指出，蘋果服務中斷暴露其營運仍有弱點，投資人應重新評估高估值背後的風險，並可考慮透過賣權價差策略，降低建立下檔保護的成本。
Khouw表示，隨著市場消化黃仁勳離職後輝達的前景，以及其他科技大廠龐大的人工智慧(AI)基礎設施支出，部分資金轉向蘋果。相較於同業大舉投入伺服器與資料中心，蘋果被視為較不受AI投資過熱疑慮影響的標的，吸引尋求相對安全的投資人。
然而，他認為，這種避險敘事已推升蘋果估值。在整體市場本益比開始明顯收縮之際，蘋果仍以接近37倍預估獲利交易，相當於股價已反映高度樂觀預期。一旦負面消息出現，市場對其安全性的信心也可能迅速動搖。
近期蘋果iCloud、Apple Pay及核心支援系統發生大規模服務中斷，成為Khouw重新檢視其估值的切入點。文章指出，官方將事件歸因於內部更新出錯；此前，微軟、美國聯邦航空總署(FAA)及銀行網路也接連出現系統異常。
Khouw認為，多起數位服務中斷集中發生，反映科技基礎設施可能比市場原先認知更脆弱。不過，這是他對系統韌性的判斷，文章並未提出證據，證明各起事件具有共同原因。
他指出，投資人願意承擔多少風險，必須與支付的估值相互衡量。按照他的比較，輝達預估本益比不到10倍，蘋果則接近標普500指數的兩倍；如此高的溢價，需要更強的營運穩定性支撐。
從技術面來看，Khouw表示，蘋果股價持續貼近布林通道等技術指標的上緣，處於對消息面相當敏感的位置。他認為，市場應思考，若要維持上漲，是否還能期待蘋果本益比進一步擴張至40倍，甚至45倍。
依照他的估算，即使估值升至45倍，上漲空間也僅約18%至19%；反之，若蘋果相對大盤的估值溢價，由目前約100%縮減至50%，本益比將降至不到28倍，對應股價可能回落近27%。這是估值變動的情境推算，並非他提出的確定跌幅預測。
儘管股票估值偏高，Khouw指出，蘋果選擇權價格相對大盤仍便宜。
整體市場隱含波動率約位於歷史第93百分位，但蘋果隱含波動率卻略低於過去一年平均；指數選擇權相對蘋果選擇權的價格，也處於第98百分位。
在他看來，股票估值偏高、選擇權相對便宜的組合，提供了重新評估避險部位的時機。
策略上，Khouw提出買進賣權價差，也就是買進一口價平或略為價外的賣權，同時賣出一口相同到期日、履約價更低的賣權。透過收取賣出賣權的權利金，可降低整體支出，也能部分抵銷時間價值耗損的影響，但下跌保護或獲利空間會受到限制。
此外，較深度價外的賣權通常具有較高隱含波動率，交易者可利用這種波動率偏斜，透過賣出較低履約價的賣權，補貼買進賣權的成本。
Khouw的核心看法是，蘋果享有的高溢價，建立在投資人相信它能抵禦其他科技股所面臨風險的基礎上。服務中斷則提醒市場，蘋果同樣存在營運弱點；當股價已反映高度樂觀預期，這些風險更值得納入評估。
輝達股價週三(18日) 震盪翻黑，終場下跌2.89%，收在每股150.96美元，自宣布黃仁勳請辭以來，5個交易日累計下跌13.11%。蘋果(AAPL-US) 升0.15%至每股352.45美元，黃仁勳請辭以來，累計下跌0.89%。

items.title: 歷時8年8個月 中韓貿易協議重大突破！《寄生上流》發行商CJ ENM飆26% 影視旅遊股齊揚
items.title_en: Eight Years and Eight Months Later, Major Breakthrough in South Korea-China Trade Agreement! CJ ENM, Publisher of Parasite, Surges 26% as Film, Gaming, and Tourism Stocks Rally
paras: 中韓擴大自由貿易協定談判取得突破，帶動南韓影視、遊戲及旅遊類股週四(19日)大漲。新協議將擴大南韓企業進入中國市場的機會，並納入電影與遊戲審查不得歧視等承諾。
不過，協議尚未正式簽署或生效，券商也提醒，內容並未明確涵蓋恢復K-pop演唱會及韓劇在中國發行。
韓劇製作公司Studio Dragon週四盤中飆漲29.96%，曾出資奧斯卡獲獎電影《寄生上流》的媒體集團CJ ENM上漲26%，旅行社Hana Tour勁揚18%，電影發行商Showbox上漲9%。遊戲股也同步走高，Krafton與Shift Up分別上漲2.69%及6.57%。
CJ ENM 是韓國大型娛樂與媒體集團 CJ 旗下的核心影視娛樂公司，也是電影《寄生上流》的重要投資與發行推手之一。
南韓產業通商資源部週三表示，歷經8年8個月磋商，南韓與中國已完成擴大自由貿易協定服務及投資領域的談判。
南韓娛樂產業受到中國限制近十年，這項協議可望為影視、遊戲及旅遊業開拓新的營收來源。
依據協議，中國將給予南韓電影、遊戲等產業最惠國待遇，意味南韓業者獲得的待遇，不得低於中國給予第三國業者的待遇。
北京也同意，對線上遊戲及電影的事前審查適用非歧視原則。南韓產業通商資源部指出，這是中國首次在貿易協定中納入此類承諾。
雙方並同意，將共同製作的合作範圍由電影擴大至電視劇、動畫、綜藝節目及紀錄片，為兩國影視業者增加合作空間。
旅遊方面，在中國23個地區營運的南韓旅行社，將可直接招攬中國居民及外籍人士參加出境旅遊，目的地涵蓋南韓及其他國家。
南韓券商韓亞證券週四發布報告，點名Studio Dragon與Hana Tour為協議最直接的受惠者。
韓亞證券估計，若中國串流平台恢復播出先前已購入的韓劇，Studio Dragon每部作品可能增加30億至40億韓元營收，營業利益增幅最高可達50%。
不過，NH投資證券對協議的解讀較為審慎。該券商在週三報告中指出，這是中國長期限制南韓文化內容以來，首次以書面形式呈現的鬆綁進展，但協議並未明確提及恢復K-pop演唱會，或允許韓劇重新在中國發行。
中國在南韓2016年部署美製薩德反飛彈系統(THAAD)後，對南韓實施貿易與文化交流限制，相關措施持續影響南韓娛樂及觀光產業。
南韓產業通商資源部表示，雙方仍在敲定技術性文字，協議尚待正式簽署及生效，實際開放時程與執行方式仍有待確認。
paras_en: South Korea and China achieved a breakthrough in expanding their free trade agreement negotiations, driving a sharp rise in South Korean film, gaming, and tourism stocks on Thursday (19th). The new agreement will broaden opportunities for South Korean companies to enter the Chinese market and includes commitments that film and game censorship will not be discriminatory.

However, the agreement has not yet been formally signed or come into effect, and brokerage firms warned that the content does not explicitly cover the restoration of K‑pop concerts or the re‑release of Korean dramas in China.

Studio Dragon, a Korean drama production company, surged 29.96% during Thursday’s trading session, while media group CJ ENM, which invested in the Oscar‑winning film Parasite, rose 26%. Travel agency Hana Tour jumped 18%, and film distributor Showbox climbed 9%. Gaming stocks also rose, with Krafton up 2.69% and Shift Up up 6.57%.
CJ ENM is the core film and entertainment arm of South Korea’s large entertainment and media conglomerate CJ, and it was one of the key investors and distributors behind the film Parasite.

On Wednesday, South Korea’s Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy announced that after 8 years and 8 months of negotiations, South Korea and China had completed talks on expanding the free trade agreement in the service and investment sectors.
South Korea’s entertainment industry has faced restrictions from China for nearly a decade, and this agreement is expected to open new revenue streams for film, gaming, and tourism businesses.

According to the agreement, China will grant South Korean film, gaming, and related industries most‑favored nation treatment, meaning that the benefits South Korean firms receive cannot be less favorable than those given to firms from third countries.

Beijing also agreed that pre‑review of online games and films will apply a non‑discriminatory principle. The Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy noted that this is the first time China has included such a commitment in a trade agreement.

Both sides also agreed to expand the scope of joint production cooperation from film to include television dramas, animation, variety shows, and documentaries, thereby increasing collaboration space for the two countries’ film industries.

In terms of tourism, South Korean travel agencies operating in 23 Chinese regions will be able to directly attract Chinese residents and foreigners to participate in outbound tourism, with destinations covering South Korea and other countries.
South Korean brokerage Han Asia Securities released a report on Thursday naming Studio Dragon and Hana Tour as the most direct beneficiaries of the agreement.

Han Asia Securities estimated that if Chinese streaming platforms resume broadcasting previously purchased Korean dramas, each Studio Dragon production could see revenue increase of 3 billion to 4 billion KRW, with operating profit growth potentially reaching 50%.

However, NH Investment & Securities took a more cautious view of the agreement. In its Wednesday report, the brokerage noted that this is the first written progress in loosening restrictions on South Korean cultural content since China imposed long‑term limits, but the agreement does not explicitly mention the restoration of K‑pop concerts or the re‑release of Korean dramas in China.

After China deployed the U.S.‑made THAAD anti‑missile system in South Korea in 2016, it imposed trade and cultural exchange restrictions on South Korea, and these measures have continued to affect South Korean entertainment and tourism industries.

The Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy stated that both sides are still finalizing technical wording, and the agreement remains to be formally signed and come into effect. The actual opening schedule and implementation methods are yet to be confirmed.

items.title: 法國砍最兇！全球資金逃離美債 9月持倉銳減755億美元 「這一國」卻創近半世紀最大買超紀錄
items.title_en: France Cuts the Most! Global Funds Flee U.S. Treasuries, September Holdings Drop by $75.5 Billion – One Country Sets a Near‑Half‑Century Record Purchase
paras: 最新數據顯示，全球資金對美債的態度在9月出現罕見分化。海外投資人持有美債規模較8月減少755億美元至9.24兆美元，創今年3月以來最大單月降幅紀錄，也是一年來最低水平，日英中三大「債主」罕見同步減持，南韓逆勢創記錄買進115億美元。需留意的是，持倉餘額下降不全是「拋售」。
美債9月遭遇新一輪拋售，彭博美債指數單月下跌2.2%，價格估值拖累明顯；按交易流量計算，海外投資者當月仍淨買超美債808億美元，只是買盤力度較8月縮水近26%。
根據美國財政部最新TIC數據，日本作為美債最大海外持有國，減持52億美元至1.063兆美元，創2024年底以來新低。市場解讀與夏季日元走弱、日本干預匯市、變賣美債籌資有關。英國減持87億美元至約9860億美元，結束連兩月創新高走勢。中國減持近270億美元至約5640億美元，續創2008年以來低點，法國減持規模更高達314億美元，為前十大持有國或地區之最。
增持則集中在比利時、加拿大與開曼群島；比利時加碼174億美元至5079億美元，市場普遍認為其中含中國透過託管帳戶持有的部位；加拿大增加31億美元。
最搶眼的是韓國。南韓投資人9月淨買入美債115億美元，創美國財政部1977年有數據以來最高紀錄，與今年上半年七個月淨賣出、2月創單月拋售紀錄形成強烈反差，同期還淨買入美股102億美元，押注AI科技股反彈。
整體來看，9月美債殖利率因升息預期與通膨韌性大幅衝高，10年期一度突破5.3%，外資一邊壓低長債殖利率、一邊在回檔中分批布局。持有水位背後，是匯率干預、託管通道、估值波動與國別偏好交織的一場全球資金再配置。
paras_en: The latest data show that global funds' attitude toward U.S. Treasuries diverged sharply in September. Overseas investors' holdings fell by $75.5 billion from August to $9.24 trillion, marking the biggest monthly decline since March this year and the lowest level in a year. The three major "bondholders" – Japan, the United Kingdom and China – unusually reduced their positions simultaneously, while South Korea bucked the trend with a record purchase of $11.5 billion. It should be noted that the drop in holdings is not entirely due to "selling".

U.S. Treasuries faced a new round of selling in September, with Bloomberg's Treasury Index down 2.2% for the month, reflecting a clear price‑valuation drag. Yet, based on transaction flow, overseas investors still net‑bought $80.8 billion of Treasuries in the month, although buying pressure shrank by about 26% compared with August.

According to the U.S. Treasury's latest TIC data, Japan – the largest foreign holder of U.S. Treasuries – reduced its stake by $5.2 billion to $1.063 trillion, a new low since the end of 2024. Markets link this to the summer yen weakness, Japanese FX intervention and the sale of Treasuries to raise funds. The United Kingdom cut $8.7 billion to about $986 billion, ending a two‑month streak of record‑high holdings. China trimmed nearly $27 billion to roughly $564 billion, a low not seen since 2008, while France’s reduction was even larger at $31.4 billion, the biggest among the top ten holder countries or regions.

Increases were concentrated in Belgium, Canada and the Cayman Islands; Belgium added $17.4 billion to reach $507.9 billion, with the market broadly assuming that part of the increase reflects positions held by China through custodial accounts. Canada raised its holdings by $3.1 billion.

The most striking case is South Korea. Korean investors net‑bought $11.5 billion of U.S. Treasuries in September, the highest monthly net purchase on record since the Treasury began keeping data in 1977, a stark contrast to the net sales over the first seven months of this year and the record‑setting monthly sell‑off in February. At the same time they also net‑bought $10.2 billion of U.S. equities, betting on a rebound in AI‑related stocks.

Overall, September Treasury yields surged sharply due to rate‑hike expectations and stubborn inflation, with the 10‑year yield briefly breaking 5.3%. Foreign investors pushed long‑term yields lower while gradually re‑entering on the pullback. Behind the holding levels lies a global capital reallocation driven by currency interventions, custodial channels, valuation swings and country‑specific preferences.

items.title: 【遠東商銀】料FED擴大升息，支撐美元走強
paras: ◆USD/JPY

美國10月零售銷售溫和增長及進口價格漲幅超過市期，強化市場對美國聯邦準備理事會(FED)在12月進一步緊縮貨幣政策的押注，而且美國科技巨頭輝達擺脫近期動璗的影響，發布優於預期的銷售預測，週三激勵股市上漲，支撐美元維持十九個月高點附近，但日本10月貿易逆差大幅縮減至4,765億日圓，其中進、出口分別較上年同期增長21.6%及20.5%，進出口額均創單月新高，並得益於全球投資強勁持續支撐半導體相關產品需求，出口連續第十四個月成長，而且日本央行(BOJ)總裁植田和男於國會發言表示，鑒於金融環境仍寬鬆，應繼續加息，同時強調需要將基礎通貨膨脹率穩定2%目標附近，並根據經濟、物價和金融環境發展調整貨幣寬鬆程度恰當，提供日圓支撐，美元兌日圓下滑至159.11低點。

隨後美國10月數據顯示，反映未來建築活動的重要指標建築許可降7.4%至年率僅129.5萬戶，但房屋開工升9.9%至年率達130.9萬戶高於預期，並據全美住宅建築商協會(NAHB)調查10月美國成屋待完成銷售指數較前月跌4.7%至2001年開始統計以來最低63，但FED理事沃勒與巴爾相繼表達應採取更激進行動應對通貨膨脹，而且FED發布10月會議紀錄顯示決策者一致同意暫時維持率不變，但部分委員認為或需升息50個基點，提振美元兌日圓至159.65高點。預估今日美元兌日圓阻力於159.50-70，支撐於158.60-80。

items.title_en: New York FX Market: Dollar Strengthens as Hawkish Fed Official Backs Aggressive Action
paras: 美元週三(18日)週三走強，升至19個月來新高，受到美國聯準會(Fed)官員華勒(Christopher Waller)的鷹派談話，以及近期經濟數據影響，市場對下個月升息的預期更加確立。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)上漲0.2%，報103.78，創2025年4月以來最高。
聯準會主席華許(Kevin Warsh)拒絕提供未來政策指引，使投資人更加依賴經濟數據，以及其他決策官員的談話，來判斷聯準會下一步動向。
華勒接受CNBC訪問時表示，如果央行希望降低通膨，就必須採取更「積極的行動」，包括在12月會議升息半個百分點，或是在會後聲明中引導市場預期，為進一步升息做好準備。
上週公布的通膨數據高於預期，使市場完全反映聯準會12月升息25個基點的預期，同時認為升息50個基點仍存在小幅可能性。芝商所(CME Group)FedWatch工具顯示，週二公布數據指出，美國10月零售銷售溫和成長，進一步強化市場對下個月升息的預期。
Monex USA駐華盛頓交易部門資深總監Juan Perez表示，「目前聯準會似乎非常堅定的準備升息，甚至可能採取更激進的升息方式。」
Perez指出，「這正是目前支撐美元走強的市場信念。」
不過，策略師也警告，美元若要延續升勢，可能需要新的利多催化因素。
Pepperstone研究策略師Dilin Wu表示，「若要推動美元從目前水準進一步顯著走高，市場可能需要開始反映2027年更為激進的升息路徑。」
CME FedWatch工具顯示，交易員預期，12個月後聯準會基準利率將較目前上升約75個基點，來到4.50%至4.75%的區間。投資人也將密切關注紐約聯準銀行總裁威廉斯(John Williams)、聯準會理事巴爾(Michael Barr)，以及明尼阿波利斯聯準銀行總裁卡什卡里(Neel Kashkari)稍晚的談話，以判斷央行下一步政策方向。
美元漲勢已將其他主要貨幣推向數個月來低點。
歐元兌美元下跌0.2%，至1.09735美元，盤中一度觸及2025年4月以來最低。

日元大致持平，報159.29日元兌1美元。日本央行(BoJ)總裁植田和男重申，貨幣政策仍有進一步緊縮的必要。日元目前仍接近日本政府今年7月曾進場干預、試圖支撐疲弱日元時的價位。
市場也關注預定於週四在深圳舉行的三方會談，與會者包括美國總統川普、中國國家主席習近平，以及俄羅斯總統普丁(Vladimir Putin)。會談可能涉及俄羅斯對烏克蘭的戰爭、伊朗戰爭，以及貿易、AI與核武等議題。

paras_en: The dollar strengthened on Wednesday (the 18th), reaching a 19‑month high, boosted by hawkish comments from Fed official Christopher Waller and recent economic data, solidifying market expectations of a rate hike next month.
In the New York close, the dollar index (DXY), which tracks the greenback against six major currencies, rose 0.2% to 103.78, the highest since April 2025.
Fed Chair Kevin Warsh refused to provide forward guidance, causing investors to rely more on economic data and remarks from other policymakers to gauge the Fed’s next move.

In a CNBC interview, Waller said that if the central bank wants to bring inflation down, it must take more “aggressive action,” including a 0.5‑percentage‑point rate hike at the December meeting or guiding market expectations in the post‑meeting statement to prepare for further hikes.

Last week’s inflation data came in hotter than expected, leading the market to fully price in a 25‑basis‑point Fed hike in December while still seeing a small chance of a 50‑basis‑point increase. CME Group’s FedWatch tool showed that Tuesday’s data, which reported modest growth in U.S. retail sales for October, further reinforced expectations of a rate hike next month.
Juan Perez, senior director of Monex USA’s Washington trading desk, said, “The Fed now appears very resolute in preparing to raise rates, and may even adopt a more aggressive tightening path.”
Perez added, “That is the market belief currently underpinning the dollar’s strength.”
However, strategists warned that for the dollar to keep climbing, a new bullish catalyst may be needed.

Dilin Wu, a strategist at Pepperstone, said, “To push the dollar significantly higher from current levels, the market may need to start pricing in a more aggressive rate‑hike trajectory through 2027.”

CME’s FedWatch tool shows traders expect the Fed’s benchmark rate to be about 75 basis points higher in 12 months, landing in the 4.50%‑4.75% range. Investors will also watch later remarks from New York Fed President John Williams, Fed Governor Michael Barr, and Minneapolis Fed President Neel Kashkari to gauge the central bank’s next policy step.
The dollar’s rally has pushed other major currencies toward multi‑month lows.
The euro fell 0.2% against the dollar to $1.09735, briefly touching its lowest level since April 2025.
The pound slipped 0.3% to $1.3165, a one‑month low. Data showed Britain’s core inflation for October held steady month‑over‑month, easing market expectations of an imminent BoE rate hike.

The yen was roughly flat at ¥159.29 per dollar. Bank of Japan Governor Kazuo Ueda reiterated that monetary policy still needs further tightening. The yen remains near the level the Japanese government intervened at in July this year to support the weak currency.

items.title: 美股牛市還能跑多久？高盛：2027年再漲17% 標普上看8700點 但最強獲利成長階段已過
items.title_en: How Long Can the US Bull Market Run? Goldman Sachs: 17% Rise by 2027, S&P 500 Target 8,700 Points
paras: 高盛最新預測，美股牛市將延續至2027年，但回報率將較前幾年降溫，標普500指數明年底有望上看8700點，較目前水準上漲約17%，低於過去四年21%的年化報酬率。
高盛美股策略首席分析師Ben Snider在最新研究報告中表示，企業獲利成長仍是股市主要支撐，但隨著AI相關資本支出逐漸放緩，獲利增速也將回落。
Snider在報告中指出，標普成分股企業獲利增速將從2026年的30%降至2027年的18%，並可能持續放緩至2028年。「我們預估，隨著企業獲利成長放緩，2027年股票回報率也將有所回落。」
儘管如此，高盛認為目前美股估值仍屬合理。標普今年來持續刷新歷史高點，企業獲利快速成長使本益比倍數下降，目前指數預期本益比約18倍，待第三季財報全數公布後，標普500成分股企業可望連三季實現超過25%的獲利增長。
不過，2027年市場仍面臨兩大壓力：利率可能進一步走升，以及AI投資前景的不確定性，兩者皆可能限制股價上行空間。
Snider指出，企業獲利前景是2027年美股展望的最大變數。在悲觀情境下，若標普獲利預期回落至過去30年趨勢水準，同時本益比降至30年平均17倍，可能下跌約23%至5600點附近。反之，若AI資本支出週期比預期更強勁，或生產率成長超乎預期，推動獲利前景進一步改善，標普到2027年底可望上漲近30%至9400點。AI投資的持續性與實際回報，將決定下一階段美股表現。
產業配置上，高盛預估超大規模雲端企業將繼續受惠AI投資週期，長期大規模回購股票的「回購貴族」也有望表現突出。
值得注意的是，能源基礎設施供應商可能成為2027年獲利增長加速最明顯的群體之一，隨著AI相關基建持續推進，這類企業獲利前景可望改善。
此外，高盛建議關注醫療保健與必需消費品行業，這些類股能提供不同於科技股的配置選擇，在市場波動加劇時發揮分散風險的作用。
根據高盛判斷，2027年美股仍有望延續牛市，但驅動力將從AI資本開支帶動的高速增長，轉向更廣泛的企業獲利改善。對投資人而言，AI熱潮能否真正轉化為生產率提升與利潤增長，將決定標普最終趨近8700點的基準目標，或是向9400點的樂觀情境邁進。
paras_en: Goldman Sachs’ latest forecast suggests the US bull market will continue until 2027, but returns will cool off compared to previous years. The S&P 500 is expected to reach about 8,700 points by the end of next year, a rise of roughly 17% from current levels, below the 21% annualized return of the past four years.

Goldman Sachs’ U.S. equity strategy chief analyst Ben Snider said in a new research report that corporate earnings growth remains the main support for the market, but as AI‑related capital spending slows, earnings growth will also decline.

Snider noted that earnings growth for S&P component companies is projected to fall from 30% in 2026 to 18% in 2027, and may continue to slow into 2028. ‘We expect that as corporate earnings growth slows, the 2027 stock return rate will also decline,’ he said.

Despite this, Goldman Sachs believes current U.S. equity valuations remain reasonable. The S&P has been breaking historical highs this year, and rapid earnings growth has lowered the price‑to‑earnings multiple to about 18×. After the full Q3 earnings are released, S&P component companies could achieve more than 25% earnings growth for three consecutive quarters.
However, the market will still face two major pressures in 2027: rates could rise further, and the uncertainty around AI investment prospects could limit upside potential.

Snider pointed out that corporate earnings prospects are the biggest variable for the 2027 U.S. equity outlook. In a pessimistic scenario, if S&P earnings expectations fall to the 30‑year trend level and the P/E ratio drops to the 30‑year average of 17×, the index could fall about 23% to around 5,600 points. Conversely, if AI capital spending cycles are stronger than expected or productivity growth exceeds expectations, pushing earnings prospects further, the S&P could rise nearly 30% to 9,400 points by the end of 2027. The sustainability and actual return of AI investment will determine the next phase of U.S. equity performance.

In terms of sector allocation, Goldman Sachs expects ultra‑large cloud companies to continue benefiting from the AI investment cycle, and long‑term large‑scale share‑repurchase “buy‑back aristocrats” are also likely to perform strongly.

Notably, energy infrastructure suppliers could become one of the most obvious groups to accelerate earnings growth in 2027, as AI‑related infrastructure continues to advance and improve the earnings outlook for these firms.

Additionally, Goldman Sachs recommends paying attention to healthcare and consumer staples, as these sectors offer a different allocation choice from tech stocks and can provide risk diversification when market volatility intensifies.

According to Goldman Sachs’ assessment, the U.S. equity market can still continue its bull run in 2027, but the driving force will shift from high‑growth AI capital spending to broader corporate earnings improvement. For investors, whether the AI boom can truly translate into productivity gains and profit growth will determine whether the S&P ultimately approaches the 8,700‑point target or moves toward the optimistic 9,400‑point scenario.

However, the “national team” took a defensive stance and effectively steadied the market, and the Taiwan stock market turned red again during trading. The market is closely watching whether the NT$33 level is the central bank’s tolerance floor.

The New Taiwan dollar opened today at NT$32.83, up 0.02, but immediately weakened, sinking lower throughout the session. By 11:15 a.m., it fell to a low of NT$33.002, a depreciation of over 0.45%, making it the weakest major Asian currency intraday.
By contrast, the Korean won appreciated about 0.4%, while the Chinese yuan, Japanese yen and Singapore dollar each slipped roughly 0.05%, and the U.S. dollar index rebounded about 0.1%.

Corporate analysts say the National Security Fund is waiting to enter around the 40,000‑point level, watching whether a second leg of a negative test forms at that point. In the short term, Taiwan stocks will undergo repeated negative tests amid uncertainty in the AI macro environment. Today also coincides with the settlement of Taiwan index futures, so caution is needed against foreign investors pushing prices down for settlement, and positions after the roll‑over should be monitored.

items.title_en: <NY Forex> Dollar Falls Yet Still Near 2025‑April High as US Economic Data Shows Mixed Signals
paras: 美元週二(17日) 自近期高點回落，但仍接近 2025 年 4 月以來最強水準，美國公布的經濟數據喜憂參半，顯示消費支出維持穩定，但房市景氣轉弱。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)下跌 0.1%，報 103.44。過去五個交易日累計上漲近 2%，美元指數近期受到通膨數據偏熱及聯準會(Fed)官員鷹派談話支撐。
不過，策略師認為，美元此次回落只是近期強勢反彈後的短暫停頓，而非更大幅度回檔的開始。
Corpay 首席市場策略師 Karl Schamotta 表示，「自上週聯準會理事華勒(Christopher Waller) 轉向鷹派立場，加上美國通膨加速升溫，推高市場利率預期並擴大各貨幣之間的利差以來，美元相較於所有主要貨幣對手幾乎一路占上風。」
週二公布的數據顯示，美國 10 月零售銷售溫和成長，但在物價上漲之際，家庭減少購買汽車及其他高單價商品。
另一項週二公布的調查顯示，11 月美國住宅建商信心大幅下滑，降至逾 14 年半以來低點。房貸利率上升使潛在買家暫緩購屋，加上移民政策收緊導致勞工短缺，進一步推高建商成本。
投資人仍深信，聯準會為了抑制通膨，將於 12 月升息。芝商所(CME)FedWatch 工具顯示，交易員預期聯準會 12 月將升息 1 碼。
Brown Brothers Harriman 外匯團隊全球市場策略主管 Elias Haddad 在報告中表示，「隨著其他主要央行收緊貨幣政策，與聯準會之間的政策分歧縮小，美元近期漲勢可能已經過度。」
Haddad 進一步指出，「儘管如此，美國經濟成長穩健、勞動市場狀況良好，加上核心通膨居高不下，仍使美元整體走勢偏向看漲。」
科技股動向
近期 AI 與科技股遭遇拋售，市場受到多項因素衝擊，包括輝達(NVDA-US)執行長突然離職、美國期中選舉由民主黨大勝，以及市場擔憂以債務融資推動的 AI 基礎設施擴張可能帶來風險，投資人的風險偏好因此受到打擊，市場氣氛轉趨緊張。
接下來，輝達的財報及 Anthropic 預計週四登場的市場首秀，將成為檢驗市場對 AI 投資情緒的重要關鍵。
對風險較敏感的貨幣，包括澳幣與紐幣，過去六個交易日分別下跌 2.7% 與 2.3%。
若市場動盪進一步加劇，投資人可能轉向美元尋求避險，短期內有利美元走勢。然而，若 AI 投資題材遭遇更長時間的衝擊，這項長期主導美國市場的投資熱潮，也可能削弱市場對美元的需求。
Corpay 的 Schamotta 表示，「AI 投資題材一直是吸引外國資金流入美國資產的主要磁石之一。如果市場隨著時間推移逐漸降低對 AI 熱潮的預期，投資人就不會再問『我要躲到哪裡避險？』，而會開始思考『為什麼我的美國資產配置比重這麼高？』」
另一方面，歐元兌美元上漲 0.2%，至 1.10133 美元，稍早盤中一度跌至 1.0983 美元，創 19 個月新低。
Rabobank 外匯策略主管 Jane Foley 表示，市場可能先在 1.10 美元附近進入一段整理期，之後才會有足夠信心進一步推低歐元。
美元兌日元下跌 0.1%，至 159.30 日圓，距離 160 日元關卡僅一步之遙。交易員認為，160 日元可能是日本當局再次進場干預、支撐日元的觸發水準。
Foley 表示，「市場對干預措施抱持戒心，正是美元兌日元從 160 日元回落的原因之一。」她形容，160 日元是「極難突破」的關卡。
她補充指出，日本在 7 月與美國聯手干預匯市、支撐日元的行動，顯示日本政府捍衛本國貨幣的決心相當強烈。
英鎊兌美元上漲 0.3%，至 1.32215 美元，市場正等待週三公布的通膨數據。

paras_en: The dollar slipped from recent highs on Tuesday (the 17th) but remains close to its strongest level since April 2025, as US economic data released was mixed, showing stable consumer spending but a weakening housing market.

In the New York close, the dollar index (DXY), which tracks the greenback against six major currencies, fell 0.1% to 103.44. Over the past five trading days it has risen almost 2%, with the index recently supported by hotter‑than‑expected inflation data and hawkish comments from Federal Reserve officials.
However, strategists say the dollar’s pullback is only a brief pause after a recent strong rebound, not the start of a larger correction.

Corpay chief market strategist Karl Schamotta said, “Since Fed Governor Christopher Waller turned hawkish last week and US inflation accelerated, pushing up market rate expectations and widening currency differentials, the dollar has been dominant against virtually all major peers.”
Data released on Tuesday showed US retail sales for October grew modestly, but as prices rose households cut back on buying cars and other high‑priced items.

Another survey released on Tuesday indicated US home‑builder confidence plunged sharply in November, falling to its lowest level in more than 14‑and‑a‑half years. Rising mortgage rates have delayed prospective buyers, and tighter immigration policy has created labor shortages that further raise builders’ costs.
Investors remain convinced the Fed will raise rates in December to curb inflation. CME’s FedWatch tool shows traders expect a one‑point rate hike at the December meeting.

Brown Brothers Harriman’s global markets FX chief Elias Haddad wrote, “With other major central banks tightening and the policy gap with the Fed narrowing, the dollar’s recent rally may already be over‑done.”
Haddad added, “Nevertheless, solid US economic growth, a strong labour market and persistently high core inflation keep the dollar’s overall outlook bullish.”
Tech‑stock moves

Recent AI and tech stocks have faced sell‑offs, hit by several factors including Nvidia’s (NVDA‑US) CEO’s sudden departure, a Democratic landslide in the US mid‑term elections, and market worries that debt‑financed AI infrastructure expansion could pose risks, dampening investors’ risk appetite and tightening market sentiment.
Going forward, Nvidia’s earnings and Anthropic’s market debut slated for Thursday will be key gauges of sentiment toward AI investments.
Risk‑sensitive currencies such as the Australian and New Zealand dollars have each fallen over the past six trading days, down 2.7% and 2.3% respectively.

If market turbulence intensifies, investors may flee to the dollar for safety, supporting it in the short term. Yet if the AI theme suffers a prolonged hit, the long‑standing driver of US market inflows could also reduce demand for the greenback.

Schamotta of Corpay said, “AI has been one of the main magnets pulling foreign capital into US assets. If the market’s enthusiasm for AI wanes over time, investors will stop asking ‘Where should I hedge?’ and start questioning ‘Why is my US asset allocation so high?’”
On the other side, the euro rose 0.2% against the dollar to $1.10133, after briefly slipping to $1.0983 earlier in the session, a 19‑month low.
Rabobank FX strategy head Jane Foley said the market may first consolidate around $1.10 before gaining enough confidence to push the euro lower.
The dollar fell 0.1% against the yen to ¥159.30, just a step away from the ¥160 barrier. Traders think ¥160 could trigger another intervention by Japanese authorities to support the yen.
Foley noted, “Caution about possible intervention is one reason the dollar‑yen pair has retreated from ¥160,” describing ¥160 as a “very hard‑to‑break” level.
She added that Japan’s joint intervention with the US in July to support the yen showed the Japanese government’s strong resolve to defend its currency.
The pound rose 0.3% against the dollar to $1.32215 as markets await Wednesday’s inflation data release.

《MarketWatch》報導，美元正重新成為全球金融市場的重要變量。美國經濟表現強於其他主要經濟體、AI基礎設施投資持續吸引海外資金，加上Fed可能進一步升息，推動美元近期加速走強。
美銀全球研究部投資策略師Michael Hartnett上周警告，若美元持續飆升，將成為全球金融市場的「破壞球」，對風險資產構成嚴重威脅。專家指出，美國經濟相對強勁、利率預期偏高，加上AI投資熱潮吸引海外資金，正推升美元走勢。
分析認為，美元升值通常伴隨融資成本上升與金融條件緊縮，對全球股市、債市等風險資產形成普遍壓力。
歷史數據顯示，多數資產與美元呈負相關，僅原油及能源股例外。此外，美元走強將加重以美元借貸的海外企業償債負擔，並可能使國際資金回流美國，進一步壓抑非美市場表現。
在AI浪潮方面，高盛策略師發現，美元漲勢與AI相關股票表現密切連動，無論市場涨跌皆然。AI企業股價走強吸引海外資金湧入，形成「AI股漲—美元升」的正向循環。
高盛預估，美元升值態勢可能延續至2027年，但速度將放緩。不過，若資料中心建設因故減速，AI動能減弱，美元升勢也將面臨回落風險。
Fed後續利率決策仍是關鍵變數。市場預期Fed可能繼續升息，支撐美元偏強格局。
Sevens Report Research創辦人Tom Essaye指出，短期美股或許尚能承受，但若美元指數升至105或更高水平，將開始對標普500等主要指數造成實質衝擊，投資人須嚴防美元過熱引發的金融動盪。
paras_en: The dollar index slipped 0.1% during Asian trading on Tuesday (the 17th), but on Monday it rose to 103.7, a 19‑month high, prompting Wall Street strategists to worry that if the dollar’s rise accelerates, the strong dollar that has been supporting U.S. assets could instead become a “disruptive force” that fuels volatility in U.S. equities.

MarketWatch reports that the dollar is re‑emerging as a key variable in global financial markets. A U.S. economy that is performing better than other major economies, continued overseas inflows into AI infrastructure investments, and the prospect of further Fed rate hikes are all driving the dollar’s recent acceleration.

Bank of America Global Research investment strategist Michael Hartnett warned last week that a persistently soaring dollar would become a “disruptive ball” for global financial markets, posing a serious threat to risk assets. Experts note that a relatively strong U.S. economy, higher‑than‑expected rate expectations, and the AI investment boom attracting foreign capital are all pushing the dollar higher.
Analysts say that dollar appreciation usually comes with higher financing costs and tighter financial conditions, creating broad pressure on global equities, bonds and other risk assets.

Historical data show that most assets have a negative correlation with the dollar, with oil and energy stocks as the only exceptions. A stronger dollar also raises the debt‑servicing burden for overseas companies that borrow in dollars and could trigger a repatriation of international capital to the United States, further dampening performance in non‑U.S. markets.

On the AI front, Goldman Sachs strategists have found that the dollar’s rise is closely linked to the performance of AI‑related stocks, regardless of overall market direction. Strong AI stock gains attract foreign capital, creating a positive feedback loop of “AI stock rally → dollar rise.”

Goldman Sachs projects that the dollar’s appreciation could continue through 2027, albeit at a slower pace. However, if data‑center construction slows for any reason and AI momentum weakens, the dollar’s upward trajectory could face a pull‑back risk.
Future Fed rate decisions remain a key variable. Markets expect the Fed may keep raising rates, supporting a relatively strong dollar environment.

Tom Essaye, founder of Sevens Report Research, notes that U.S. equities may still hold up in the short term, but if the dollar index climbs to 105 or higher, it will begin to deliver material blows to major indices such as the S&P 500, and investors need to guard against financial turbulence sparked by an overheated dollar.
